jobs.title: Senior Leadership & AI Enablement Consultant (w/d/m)
jobs.description:
Führungskräfte sollen entscheiden, wo AI in ihrem Bereich hilft. Viele können nicht einschätzen, ob ein Prozess RPA, generative AI oder einen Agenten braucht und ob die Daten reichen. Mit dir lernen sie das an einem eigenen Use Case, den sie über mehrere Wochen bearbeiten.  WE BUILD AI ist eine AI-Beratung mit eigenem Engineering in Köln. Wir sind rund zehn Leute und arbeiten mit Mittelstand und Konzernen. Uns geht es um AI, die in Prozessen und in der Wertschöpfung wirkt.

Deine Rolle

Gemeinsam mit einer Partnerberatung für Führung und Change bauen wir gerade ein Programm für Führungskräfte im Konzernumfeld auf. Es verbindet Präsenzblöcke, eine Praxisphase am eigenen Use Case und Coaching über mehrere Wochen. Du leitest Präsenzblöcke allein und deckst dabei Führung, Technologie, Prozesse und Daten ab, immer aus Sicht der Führungskraft. Dafür bist du etwa einmal im Monat für zwei Tage vor Ort, in NRW und Norddeutschland.  Die übrige Zeit arbeitest du in unserem Trainingsbereich, den wir gerade ausbauen. Dort gibst du Trainings und Workshops bei weiteren Kund:innen und sammelst Use Cases für unsere Discovery Sprints. Deine Arbeit wirkt, wenn Use Cases nach dem Training weiterlaufen und Projekte daraus entstehen.

Aufgaben

Du leitest Präsenzblöcke von zwei Tagen allein und führst die Gruppe von der eigenen Rolle bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage.

Technologie erklärst du so, dass Führungskräfte einordnen können, was RPA, klassische AI, generative AI und Agents leisten.

Mit Design Thinking und Service Design führst du die Teilnehmenden vom Pain Point zum priorisierten Use Case.

In der Praxisphase coachst du die Gruppe remote und gibst Feedback auf Problemdefinition, Datenlage und erste Lösungsideen.

Übergaben und Trainingsdesign stimmst du eng mit den Trainer:innen der Partnerberatung ab.

Die Inhalte prüfst du jedes Quartal und passt Beispiele und Übungen an neue Entwicklungen an.

Außerhalb des Programms gibst du Trainings und Workshops und bringst vielversprechende Use Cases in Discovery Sprints.

Formate, Methoden und Vorlagen für unseren Trainingsbereich baust du mit auf.

Was du mitbringst

Du hast mehrere Jahre Trainings oder Workshops für Führungskräfte gegeben, gern auch mehrtägige Formate.

Eine Gruppe aus Abteilungs- und Bereichsleitungen hältst du zwei Tage allein bei der Sache, auch bei kritischen Rückfragen.

AI nutzt du selbst jeden Tag. Wie Sprachmodelle und Agents funktionieren und wo ihre Grenzen liegen, kannst du einfach erklären.

Design Thinking, Service Design oder Prozessanalyse hast du in echten Projekten eingesetzt.

Bei Daten bleibst du skeptisch und erkennst, wann ein Dashboard eine Entscheidung trägt.

Erfahrung mit großen Organisationen hilft, etwa mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und AI Act.

Idealerweise kommst du aus Beratung, Learning & Development, Organisationsentwicklung oder Change Management.

Reisen gehört für dich dazu, und Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher.

Was wir bieten

Remote-Arbeit mit regelmäßigen Tea

jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Willkommen bei CBTW! Wir sind ein innovatives Team mit über 3.000 Mitarbeitern in 21 Ländern und führend in den Bereichen Strategie & Governance, Software-Engineering, Datenanalyse & KI und mehr.  Als Mitglied unseres Teams bei CBTW arbeitest Du in einem inspirierenden Umfeld an anspruchsvollen Projekten. Wir fördern die Entwicklung der Experten von morgen und schätzen Deine Ideen. Wenn Du bereit bist, die Zukunft der datengetriebenen Transformation mit einem hochmotivierten Team zu gestalten, bewirb Dich jetzt bei CBTW! Zusammen schaffen wir Großartiges.  Aufgaben  Wir suchen einen engagierten  Data & AI Engineer  mit Begeisterung für Data Engineering, Machine Learning und Artificial Intelligence zur Verstärkung unseres Teams.  In dieser Rolle entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit unseren Consultants innovative datengetriebene Lösungen und begleitest unsere Kunden von der Konzeption über die technische Implementierung bis hin zum produktiven Einsatz. Dabei verbindest Du Deine Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung mit modernen Daten- und KI-Technologien.

Deine Aufgaben:

Konzeption, Entwicklung und Implementierung datengetriebener Anwendungen und KI-gestützter Lösungen

Entwicklung, Training, Validierung und Optimierung von Machine-Learning-Modellen mit Python und modernen ML-Frameworks

Entwicklung und Integration innovativer KI-Anwendungen, insbesondere im Bereich Generative AI

Aufbau, Automatisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Datenpipelines zur Verarbeitung, Transformation und Bereitstellung von Daten

Analyse, Aufbereitung und Visualisierung komplexer Datenbestände mithilfe von Python und SQL

Integration, Deployment und Betrieb von Machine-Learning- und KI-Lösungen in Cloud- und On-Premise-Umgebungen

Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und Modellierungsansätze im Bereich Data Science, Machine Learning und Artificial Intelligence

Ableitung datenbasierter Handlungsempfehlungen und verständliche Aufbereitung technischer Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden

Aktive Mitgestaltung technischer Lösungsansätze und Architekturentscheidungen

Eigenverantwortliche Übernahme technischer Arbeitspakete sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Projektteams

Es ist unwahrscheinlich, dass jede:r Kandidat:in all diese Anforderungen erfüllt. Wenn Deine Erfahrungen anders sind und Du glaubst, dass Du einen Mehrwert für die Position bieten kannst, lass uns gerne darüber sprechen!  Qualifikation

Unsere Anforderungen:

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Artificial Intelligence oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

Praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning oder Artificial Intelligence

Gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung datengetriebener Anwendungen

Gute SQL-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken

Erfahrung mit Machine-Learning-Frameworks und Python-Bibliotheken wie scikit-learn, TensorFlow

jobs.title: Art Director (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Stelle

Du bist du bei bereit, deine künstlerischen Talente und deine Leidenschaft für Design in eine Karriere als Art Director umzuwandeln? Möchtest du in einer inspirierenden Umgebung arbeiten und gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team innovative Konzepte entwickeln? Sind Sie ein Photoshop-Magier, können Sie ein Video für soziale Netzwerke schneiden, können Sie Text in After Effects fliegen lassen. Freust du dich darauf, KI als Sparringspartner und technischen Helfer zu nutzen?

Wenn du bereit bist, Teil unseres kreativen Teams zu werden und deine Fähigkeiten als Art Director einzusetzen, dann sende uns noch heute deine Bewerbungsunterlagen.
Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören und gemeinsam großartige Projekte zu verwirklichen!

Deine Aufgaben

➡️  Social-Media-Konzepte:  Du unterstützt das Team bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung kreativer Social-Media-Konzepte für unsere Kund:innen,
➡️  Erstellung von Visuals:  Du erstellst visuelle Inhalte für verschiedene Social-Media-Plattformen (Linkedin, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, etc.), einschließlich Layouts, Grafiken und Illustrationen,
➡️  Trend Recherche:  Du behältst relevante Design- und Social-Media-Trends im Auge, recherchierst aktiv und teilst deine Erkenntnisse mit dem Visual Team.

Das bringst du mit

✅ Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung,
✅ 2-4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Gestaltung digitaler Medien (z. B. Grafiken für soziale Medien, grundlegende Videobearbeitung usw.),
✅ Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Design-Tools (Adobe Creative Suite mit Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects),
✅ Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift,
✅ Zuverlässigkeit und die Fähigkeit, auch bei hohem Arbeitsaufkommen klar zu priorisieren,
✅ Kreativität sowie ein gutes Gespür für Ästhetik und visuelle Kommunikation zeichnen dich aus,
✅ Teamfähigkeit und Lust in einem multidisziplinären Team zu arbeiten,
✅ Eigeninitiative und den Anspruch, Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern,
✅ Vor allem aber Persönlichkeit, denn der ist uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss.

Warum StoryMachine

⭐️ Dynamisches Umfeld:  Bei StoryMachine erwartet Dich ein dynamisches Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, in dem Deine Ideen und Dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein gefragt sind.

⭐️ Persönliche Entwicklung:  Du wirst von Anfang an herausfordernde und vielfältige Aufgaben erhalten, die Dein Potenzial entfalten und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung fördern. Zudem hast Du die Möglichkeit, in Deiner neuen Rolle eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.

⭐️  Feedback-Kultur:  Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche, bei denen wir nicht nur Dir Feedback geben, sondern auch Dein Feedback einfordern.

⭐️ Teamgeist:  Bei uns findest Du ein herzliches, diverses und ambitioniertes Team, das gemeinsam Großes erreichen möchte. Ebenso organisieren wir regelmäßige Team-Events wie wöchentliche Teamlunches und verschiedene gemeinsame Aktivitäten.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives

Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France

Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly

Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message

Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals

Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts

Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting

Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own

Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers

Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win

Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural princ

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint

What we're building

Jiga  is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster.  The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). Think "npm install for mechanical engineers" - get the parts you need without the admin nightmare.  We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers like NASA, Google, Tesla, and Apple.

The role

We're looking for an execution-focused, zero-fluff Staff Product Manager. Someone who can take ownership and drive product initiatives with a high degree of autonomy. You'll be making calls on what we build and why, translating messy customer and operational problems into  simple  solutions, and making sure they're executed well, monitored, and improved over time.

How we actually work

We’re a small remote team made up of the best of the best. Our team members are distributed around the globe, with product and engineering talent across Europe, Israel, and the US. You’ll also work with teammates in Asia. Most of our work happens async, which is the secret sauce of our success.

High trust, low bullshit:  We don't count hours or peek over your shoulder on Slack. We trust you to get your work done and tell us when something's wrong. You'll have real ownership over what you build, no process theater, no busy-work meetings.

Question everything:  See something that doesn't make sense? Say it. Have a better way to do something? Just do it. We actually mean it when we say we want people to challenge the status quo and improve things. Our internal motto is “Don’t drink the kool-aid.”

Simple > Complicated.  Simple code, simple architecture. Simple solutions are better than complex ones.

Ship it, then improve it.  Perfection is the enemy of done. Launch now, iterate forever.

Product > Engineering.  Every line of code should make our users' lives better. We're not here to show off our algorithmic prowess - we're here to solve real business problems.

About Kernel  Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout  already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised  $20M  from top VCs and operators, and we are growing  10x YoY .

You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team

Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it)

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally. jobs.title: Senior Manager AI Content
jobs.description:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.  Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms  B. bifidum  MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört  B. bifidum  MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie  The Lancet .

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas die Zukunft der Content-Erstellung mit generativer KI gestalten? Du hast Freude daran, intelligente Workflows, Prompts und Agents aufzusetzen und mit ihrer Hilfe hochwertigen Content für eine der führenden Gesundheitsmarken Europas zu entwickeln? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen ab sofort einen  Senior Manager AI Content (w/m/d) , der unsere Marke Kijimea mit einer zukunftsweisenden AI-first-Content-Strategie erfolgreich weiterentwickelt. Du konzipierst und optimierst KI-gestützte Prozesse für die Erstellung von Text-, Bild- und Video-Content und setzt sie für Website- und Advertorial-Texte, Newsletter sowie reichweitenstarke Social-Media-Inhalte ein. Unterstütze uns dabei, die bereits heute weltweit führende Probiotika-Marke Kijimea durch intelligente, effiziente und wirkungsvolle Content-Prozesse noch erfolgreicher zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere AI-first-Strategie für die Content-Erstellung und führst KI-gestützte Prozesse von der Idee bis zur skalierbaren Umsetzung ein.

Complaints are changing faster than the teams that handle them. Generative AI makes complaints longer and easier to file: the Financial Ombudsman says up to a third of responses to its initial assessments now look AI-generated, and it has seen 200-page submissions in reply to an eight-page decision. Soon personal agents will file and chase complaints for people, so one event becomes several. UK financial services firms received 1.85 million complaints in the first half of 2026, up 6.3%, and a human still has to read and check every one. Every ombudsman referral can cost a firm £680.  It isn't only financial complaints. New kinds of regulated requests are arriving that no off-the-shelf tool handles well, such as waves of GDPR data requests from job candidates a company never hired. Each one raises the same questions: why is this happening, do we have to respond, and how do we respond fairly and on time?  We are building the AI desk that handles them. It splits a long complaint or request into its separate claims, checks each one against the policy, the customer's records and the rules, and drafts a fair, cited response within the deadline, with a handler always making the decision. Every outcome and published ombudsman decision feeds back in, so the drafts get better case by case. We start with insurers, banks and lenders, then move to utilities, telecoms and any regulated business.

jobs.description:

Responsables : Cédric SAMUEL

Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois)

Lieu de travail  : Douai – Lahure

Contexte  :  École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants :

Systèmes Numériques

Energie Environnement

Matériaux et Procédés

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École :

www.imt-nord-europe.fr  .

Contexte  :  Le projet DEFI-PIEZOCAT, soutenu par l'IMT Nord Europe et la Région Hauts-de-France, développe une technologie de rupture pour le traitement des micropolluants de l'eau (notamment les PFAS et résidus de pesticides). En rupture avec les méthodes classiques de captation (charbon actif), notre approche vise la destruction active des polluants grâce à un procédé inédit de piézocatalyse, utilisant des matériaux électroactifs 100 % biosourcés et sans fluor. Ce projet à fort potentiel de transfert technologique vise la création prochaine d'une start-up Deeptech.

Vos missions  :  Au sein de l'équipe projet, vous prendrez en charge le volet analytique visant à prouver et quantifier l'efficacité de notre technologie. Votre rôle sera centré sur la chimie analytique et la validation des performances :  ·

Mettre au point et optimiser les protocoles de dosage des polluants modèles (colorants type Bleu de Méthylène, Rhodamine B) et des cibles réelles (pesticides, PFAS) dans des matrices aqueuses.  ·

Réaliser le suivi analytique des campagnes d'essais sur des montages basiques (prélèvements, préparation d'échantillons, analyses instrumentales).  ·

The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.

You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together.

Our current data platform includes:

Ingestion: Stitch

Data warehouse: BigQuery

Transformation: dbt Cloud

Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight

What you’ll do

Data Modelling & Pipelines:  Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.

Source of Truth:  Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.

Automation:  Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.

Stakeholder Collaboration:  Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.

Quality & Governance:  Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.

AI-Ready Data:  Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer.

Champion Data Culture:  Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table.

Working with AI

AI is part of how we work every day and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye.

The Team

You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max, Data Insights, as part of our small Data team on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business.

Who you are

You have owned analytics engineering work end-to-end.

You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core).

jobs.title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
jobs.description:
Freelance Assignment
4 January to 30 April 2027 
5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays)
Reporting to COO

The Challenge  Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation.  Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through.  We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs  our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch.

What You'll Do

Keep things running

Keep ops moving:  Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks.

Run verification:  Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips.

Go deep on payments

Get up to speed:  Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most.

Fix it weekly:  Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers.

Create order:  By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute.

What You'll Bring

Must have

5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side.

Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes.

Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- IAM & Billing (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Every tenant, every user, every permission on our sovereign cloud runs through the services this squad builds, and so does every euro that gets billed. We are the Business Logic squad in the Cloud Store team at gridscale, part of OVHcloud, and we build the backend layer of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform: identity and access management, consumption tracking and billing for enterprise customers who run their cloud on their own premises, often fully air-gapped. Our first fully integrated release is out, and the next step is taking it to production grade, while the platform is becoming the foundation on which other OVHcloud products build their sovereign offerings. The design decisions this squad makes over the next year will shape all of that, and we want you in the room when they are made.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· AI Coding Agents & Agentic Workflows · Python (async) · REST · PostgreSQL · Redis

· Docker · Kubernetes · OAuth2/OIDC · Keycloak · OpenStack

Your Role💻

As a senior engineer in the squad, you own backend services end to end, from the first design sketch to running in production on Kubernetes. You make architecture calls in a domain where correctness, security and backward compatibility are not optional: billing can't be "roughly right", and an auth bug is a security incident. You write down the decisions that matter, review your teammates' designs and code, and help the whole squad raise its engineering bar. We write code to be read: clear, maintainable and easy for the next person – human or agent – to change. Our tests exist to catch real bugs, not to turn the coverage badge green. On-call is shared across the squad, and our working language is English – no German required.

For us, AI is a structural shift in how software is built, not an add-on. Agentic development runs through our entire lifecycle, from specification and design through implementation, testing and code review: AI agents do much of the work, while engineers set the direction, define the guardrails and own every merge. AI-assisted is our default - agents generate, engineers decide, every change is human-reviewed before it merges, and accountability always stays with the engineer. You already work this way every day and operate at the frontier of these tools: you know where agents excel, where they fail, and how to build workflows that deliver production-grade results in a domain where correctness and security are non-negotiable. With us, you'll push this practice further across the squad and beyond.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer(Go), Storage Platform
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

What you’ll be doing

As part of Wolt’s Platform department (Core Group), you’ll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization.

As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you’ll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more.

Our humble expectations

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience:

  • A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users.
  • Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems.
  • A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently.
  • Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change.
  • A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.

Technical proficiencies:

  • Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.
  • Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential.</

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Financial Controller who combines strong financial control expertise with a commercially-minded approach. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on complex financial topics.

Knowledge of Dutch accounting and reporting requirements.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step.  That's where you come in.  As our  Marketing Development Representative (MDR) , you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo.  You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.  This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact.  It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension.

At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.  As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step.

Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation.

Help prospects become self-serve customers

Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo.

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.  You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.  This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.  At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting.  In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.  And we build at scale. More than  600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries  rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than  $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.  If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters,  this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

jobs.title: Digital CS Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our  public roadmap  to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

The mission

Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.  Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.  You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count.  Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.

Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet.

Find the first levers:  landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly.

Agents that see:  automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks.

jobs.description:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.  That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.  The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.  As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform.

What you'll be working on:

Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.

Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries.

Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles.

Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal.

Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models.

Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production.

Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services.

Driving architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and mentoring other engineers.

Leveraging AI extensively but responsibly, including developing guardrails, agent harnesses, and tooling to maintain engineering quality in a fast-paced environment.

We primarily use  Node.js with TypeScript , with  Java and Kotlin  as a nice to have. Above all, strong engineering fundamentals matter more to us than experience with a particular language. Our technology stack also includes Temporal, SpiceDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.

This is a 80/20  hands-on technical leadership role , combining deep engineering work with architectural ownership and influence across teams.
Remote, but travel to Amsterdam or other offsite meetings in Europe might occasionally be requested

About Zable  Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to  build  the  world's best technology  to  help people get credit  and  save money .

Founded  in 2014,  profitable  since 2017, unicorn since 2021

The  number one issuer  of new credit cards and loans in the UK

Backed by  Balderton Capital  and  Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

Loved  by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.  The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.  Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Build the  best technology in-house  - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.  Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

The Bridging Department at Allica Bank is a high-energy, specialist lending team supporting established SMEs and professional property investors with fast, flexible short-term finance. Operating within a true challenger-bank environment, the team combines strong credit discipline with pragmatic decision-making, relationship-led lending, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcomes for customers.

This is a fast-paced and constantly evolving department where no two days are the same. Deals are time-critical, varied, and often bespoke, requiring commercial thinking, sound judgement, and a willingness to take ownership from day one. As the Bridging proposition continues to grow, the role and the department evolve week by week offering genuine variety, exposure, and the opportunity to help shape how the business operates.

The team is lively, proactive, and highly collaborative. People are trusted to act like owners, take responsibility for their decisions, and work closely with colleagues across Distribution, Credit, Operations, and external partners to keep things moving. There is a strong emphasis on keeping things clear and simple, working at pace, and removing unnecessary barriers to getting good deals done without compromising on risk or governance.

Role Description

The purpose of this role is to underwrite larger and more complex borrowing requests across Allica Bank’s Bridging proposition, received via a variety of origination channels. The Senior Underwriter will assess and structure lending proposals in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy, risk appetite, and asset strategy, while supporting the delivery of fast, high-quality outcomes for SME and professional property clients.  The role covers a broad range of asset classes within the Bank’s portfolio, including (but not limited to) residential investment properties, commercial and semi-commercial assets, and refurbishment transactions involving staged drawdowns.  Senior Underwriters are expected to hold a Delegated Lending Authority mandate and to provide oversight and recommendations on approvals, policy exceptions, and escalated cases, including appeals, within their delegated authority. In addition, Senior Underwriters will act as a signatory for cases falling within lower lending mandates.  Underwriters take full ownership of each deal from initial application through to completion. Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Contribute to go-to-market strategy, positioning, and customer enablement alongside commercial and clinical teams.

Analytics & Insights

Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken.

Ist-Zahlen & Treiber:

Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams.

Planung:

Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen.

Reporting:

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick.

Business Cases & Unit Economics:

Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum.

Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten.

Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen.

2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach.

Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau.

Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast.

Tour-opérateur réceptif (DMC) indépendant, nous concevons et organisons des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités en famille, en liberté ou accompagnés.  Du Canal du Midi aux Pyrénées, en passant par les Cévennes, l'Aubrac et la Catalogne, nous invitons nos voyageurs à découvrir les territoires autrement, à leur rythme et au plus près de la nature.  Notre ambition ? Développer une autre façon de voyager, plus respectueuse de l'environnement et des territoires, en privilégiant les mobilités douces, les expériences authentiques et les rencontres locales.  Pour accompagner notre développement, nous recherchons  un(e) stagiaire passionné(e) de voyages et d'outdoor pour rejoindre notre équipe d'Alénya.

Ton stage s'articulera autour de deux missions complémentaires : le marketing digital (80 %) et le conseil et la vente de voyages (20 %).

1. Marketing digital – 4 jours par semaine

SEO et rédaction web :  participer à l'optimisation du référencement naturel de notre nouveau site internet, rédiger et enrichir les contenus de nos pages destinations, séjours et articles de blog.

Acquisition digitale (SEA) :  participer au suivi et à l'analyse de nos campagnes publicitaires, en collaboration avec nos prestataires spécialisés.

Newsletters et CRM :  participer à la conception, à la rédaction et à la diffusion de nos campagnes d'e-mailing, ainsi qu'à la segmentation de notre base de contacts.

Réseaux sociaux :  contribuer à l'élaboration du calendrier éditorial, à la création de contenus et à l'animation de nos communautés.

Analyse des performances :  suivre les principaux indicateurs marketing, analyser les résultats des actions menées et proposer des pistes d'amélioration.

Développement marketing :  contribuer à la réflexion et à la mise en œuvre d'actions visant à développer la visibilité et les ventes sur l'ensemble de notre offre de voyages.

2. Conseil & vente de voyages – 1 jour par semaine

Accompagner nos clients dans le choix de leurs voyages à pied, à vélo ou en famille.

Participer à la préparation des devis et des propositions personnalisées.

Participer au suivi des demandes commerciales et contribuer à leur concrétisation.

Identifier les attentes et les motivations de nos voyageurs afin d'enrichir nos actions marketing.

Cette immersion commerciale te permettra de mieux comprendre nos clients, nos produits et les réalités de notre métier, pour donner davantage de sens à tes actions marketing.  Ces missions pourront évoluer au cours du stage, en fonction de tes compétences, de tes objectifs pédagogiques et des projets de l'entreprise. jobs.title: Director of User Experience (UX) Research
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.

You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.
  • Uncover opportunities and build a shared understanding of our users. Lead foundational and generative research that surfaces unmet needs, pain points, and emerging behaviors, and use segmentation, longitudinal, and international research to understand how different user cohorts use Discord and where their needs differ, so teams design for real people instead of assumptions.
  • Own usability and concept validation. Establish a consistent program for testing concepts, prototypes, and live experiences, so teams learn early whether ideas are desirable, usable, and valuable before investing heavily.
  • Bring a mixed-methods lens to every major decision. Partner with Data Science to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence (surveys, behavioral data, experimentation) that explains both what users do and why. Define and track experience-health measures such as satisfaction, ease, and trust over time.

jobs.title: Senior Research Programmer, Epic Developer Assistant
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Research Programmer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

  • Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting
  • Design and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine
  • Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling
  • Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation
  • Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend programmers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

  • Strong programming background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting
  • Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context programming), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work
  • Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment
  • Excellent programming skills across C++ (engine-side) and Python and/or a web backend language
  • Experience in the games industry or equivalent, developing interactive entertainment products
  • Ability to work full-stack and reason about tradeoffs across engine code, backend services

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

AI PROGRAMMER INTERN

What You'll Do

The Epic Games UE Al team is looking for a Research Engineering Intern who is excited about machine learning and artificial intelligence. Epic Games creates and deploys advanced computer vision, computer graphics and machine learning technologies to transform the production and consumption of digital media. This includes physics-based simulation, ML-based character animation, neural and inverse rendering, and automated generative animation techniques, among others. At Epic we research, develop and deploy these technologies for Unreal Engine and other Epic products.

In this role, you will

  • Assist with prototyping machine learning and generative approaches for game content creation as part of a defined project with guidance from a mentor
  • Support experiments by preparing data, running tests, collecting results, and helping document observations
  • Assist with implementing and testing research concepts using Python and relevant machine learning tools
  • Read and discuss research papers with team members to develop familiarity with current approaches and techniques
  • Work with your mentor and immediate team to support ongoing research and development projects
  • Communicate progress, ask questions, and incorporate feedback while working through assigned tasks
  • Share your work and key learnings through regular updates and a final presentation to the team

What we're looking for

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate (Bachelor's) or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Foundational programming skills in Python, with C++ experience considered a plus
  • Introductory experience with a machine learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow through coursework, academic projects, or personal pr

jobs.title: Cinematics Director
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

Cinematic Director, Fortnite Ecosystem – Cinematic Trailers

What We Do

In the Cinematics Team, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible in realtime. We are in the early stages of this growth in realtime quality work and we are growing quickly and implementing various techniques and ideas to improve what can be done in Unreal Engine. Our team is one of the few at the forefront of delivering innovation, through cinematic quality visuals.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a collaborative Cinematic Director to join our Fortnite cinematics team who can help craft high-impact trailers and short-form content that connects with the Fortnite audience.

We're looking for a hands-on filmmaker who uses Unreal Engine as a creative tool and is excited to jump into Sequencer to explore, iterate, and build.

Tone matters as much as craft. Strong comedic instincts and a feel for playful, irreverent, character-driven storytelling - someone who understands timing, performance, and visual comedy while still delivering cinematic scale and polish.

This is a highly collaborative role working alongside our existing directors and discipline leads to brainstorm, rapidly pitch, and bring ideas to life. You'll manage multiple trailers simultaneously while incorporating feedback from Marketing, Art Direction, Game Direction, and other partners without compromising the creative intent.

In this role, you will

  • Collaborate with our directors and discipline leads to define the creative vision, story, tone, and visual language for Fortnite cinematic trailers and short-form content.
  • Develop and pitch original story and comedy ideas, taking them from early concept through final delivery.
  • Work hands-on in Unreal Engine 5, building and iterating sequences in Sequencer.
  • Translate scripts and storyboards into compelling shots through composition, camera movement, performance, pacing, and visual comedy.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while synthesizing feedback from Marketing, Art Direction, Game Direction, and other creative partners.
  • Partner across Animation, Layout, Lighting, FX, Production, and Technical Art to bring the creative vision to life.
  • Collaborate with the Animat

jobs.title: Counsel (Regulatory)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

LEGAL

What We Do

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

What You'll Do

Epic's regulatory lawyers advise the company on laws and regulations worldwide. We partner with Public Policy to monitor regulatory developments and support advocacy on regulatory design; with Product Counsel on new products and their regulatory requirements; and with Compliance on the design and operation of our regulatory compliance program. We also help manage the company's response to regulatory inquiries, investigations and RFIS.

In this role, you will

  • Advise Product Counsel, Compliance and Legal leadership on global laws and regulations, with the focus of this role being on online safety frameworks such as the UK Online Safety Act and EU Digital Services Act
  • Monitor and analyse draft legislation and regulatory proposals, supporting Public Policy's advocacy efforts
  • Advise Product Counsel on new products and features and their regulatory requirements
  • Support Compliance in the operation of our regulatory compliance program and compliance strategies
  • Help manage the company's response to regulatory oversight, such as supervisory meetings and RFIs

What we're looking for

  • Qualified attorney with 5+ years experience working in regulatory compliance, either within a regulatory body, in-house or at a law firm
  • Experience with online safety regulation in the UK and/or EU
  • Knowledge of the tech industry; familiarity with video games is an advantage
  • Ability/flexibility to work US Eastern time hours
  • Comfort working with multiple stakeholders, navigating complex issues, and leading high-impact projects
  • Sound judgement and decision-making in ambiguous situations where clear guidance may be limited or non-existent
  • Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to deliver under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

jobs.title: Cyber Defense Operations Director
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

Epic's Cyber Defense Operations team protects one of the world's largest player communities, as well as the people, infrastructure, and technology that support it. As Cyber Defense Operations Director, you will own Epic's detection and response function end-to-end, leading the teams who detect, investigate, and respond to threats across the company. You will set the long-term vision for security operations, build an organization that scales with Epic's growth, and lead the shift to automated, Al-assisted operations so the team can focus on the threats that matter most. This is a player-coach role: you will lead from the front, stay hands-on alongside the team, and hold yourself to the same high standard you set for others.

In this role, you will

  • Build and lead the Cyber Defense Operations organization as a hands-on player-coach: hire and develop strong analysts, set the org structure, and stay in the work on investigations, detection, and major incidents. Coach the team through real cases, put their growth first, and clear the obstacles that slow them down
  • Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for detection, response, automation, and tooling, aligned with Epic's risk profile, business priorities, and Information Security leadership goals
  • Act as the senior incident lead for Epic's most significant security events, directing response across programming, legal, privacy, communications, and executive leadership, and briefing senior leaders on impact and risk
  • Own detection and response coverage across cloud, corporate, endpoint, identity, and production environments, directing investment toward the threats that pose the most risk to Epic
  • Champion automation and AI-agent workflows across security operations, partnering with security programming leadership to set guardrails, validation standards, and where human review is required
  • Run Cyber Defense Operations as a bus

jobs.description:

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

Epic's third-party content group brings the world's best-known entertainment and gaming IP into Fortnite as creator-enabled experiences built with Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN), funding and shipping a growing slate of licensed and partner titles through external studios and vendors while operating the live platform where that content is discovered and grows.

As the program scales with more titles, larger partnerships and major launches ahead, this role will be the production spine of that growth, leading production across the licensed IP slate end to end, coordinating delivery with internal development and platform teams, managing production relationships with licensors and external studios, and overseeing live operations once titles launch. Working alongside design, art, PM and engineering leads, you will own launch readiness, budgets, vendor contracts and capacity plans while building and leading a production team that can scale with the slate.

In this role, you will

  • Shipping and launch readiness: Own launch readiness per title, chairing weekly status across all workstreams (creator tools, island production, publishing and access, discovery placement, IP and content moderation, brand compliance, creator-facing UX, monetisation, documentation, marketing and QA), assigning owners, chasing actions and holding the quality bar
  • Partner production management: Be the production face to our licensor partners, aligning on brand guidelines and content review while carrying decisions between partners, legal, business development, and the development team
  • Platform liveops: Own the live operating rhythm of the platform, including release cadence, events, merchandising, discovery and monetisation health, and the feedback loop from live metrics back into the slate and roadmap
  • Production team leadership: Build and run the production organisation with clear ownership, real delegation, and team ceremonies that hold up as the slate scales across UK and US timezones
  • Budget, vendors and cap

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

What You'll Do

As a Director of Product Management, you will be a key leader within the Discovery product org. You will help define the strategy and flywheel of the Discovery system, working closely with Development, Design, and Data Science teams to ship features and optimize systems that connect players with the right content at the right time. You will translate high-level strategic goals into actionable roadmaps, write detailed requirements, and drive cross-functional execution. You will partner with marketing, content strategy, and creator initiatives teams to ensure their needs are reflected in the product.

In this role, you will

  • Own product strategy and execution for defined areas of the Discover surface, developing roadmaps that improve player discovery and drive growth
  • Write detailed business and product requirements that guide design and technical specifications, partnering directly with Development and Data Science to ship high-quality systems and features
  • Develop and refine "playbooks" and operational strategies that leverage Discover features to achieve initiative goals, using data to measure effectiveness and iterate
  • Build and present product and feature concepts to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, clearly articulating impact, rationale, and expected outcomes
  • Drive live operations execution for Discover initiatives, ensuring consistent quality and identifying opportunities for improvement through data analysis

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to discovery systems, content platforms, recommendation engines, or large-scale consumer products
