jobs.title: Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

We're seeking a Gaming Threat Intelligence Analyst to identify, investigate, and disrupt the people who cheat, defraud, or abuse Epic's games and players. You'll track cheat developers, account sellers, and fraud operations back to the people and infrastructure behind them, then work with Ecosystem Security and Legal to turn that research into mitigations, enforcement, and legal action. This role owns investigations from first lead to finished report with minimal oversight.

In this role, you will

  • Investigate cheat developers, sellers and resellers, account sellers, tournament cheaters, DDoS providers, and exploit developers targeting Epic's games
  • Identify the people, networks, and infrastructure behind cheat products and fraud schemes, not only the products themselves
  • Investigate fraud and abuse across the ecosystem, including V-Bucks fraud, Support-A-Creator fraud, and map payout fraud
  • Monitor cheat communities and underground markets for new features, techniques, and trends, and feed findings into technical mitigations and enforcement decisions
  • Track account compromise methods and social engineering tactics used against players
  • Research and maintain Epic's gaming threat landscape, including the leading threat actors, their methods, and where they are likely to move next
  • Prioritize actors by impact and build evidence packages that support takedowns, payment disruption, and litigation, and support Legal throughout the legal process
  • Work with external intel partners on reporting, cheat testing, and attribution, and exchange intelligence with gaming industry peers
  • Support incident response with research on cheats, exploits, compromised accounts, and leaks
  • Write case reports and contribute to quarterly threat reporting, and own small projects from the team backlog end to end

jobs.title: Hard Surface Outsource Lead
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Cosmetics Lead, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Fortnite. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modelling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modeling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner
  • Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

MARKETING

What We Do

We deliver the most innovative gaming experiences possible to players around the world. Whether through community outreach, world-class events, or partnership integrations, the Epic Games Publishing and Marketing teams seek to surprise players with new experiences every time they drop in to play.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking a highly strategic, culturally fluent, and operationally rigorous Influencer Marketing Director to lead creator and talent partnerships across Fortnite. This role will shape how creators, streamers, athletes, musicians, entertainers, and their communities connect with Fortnite through major launches, live-service moments, partnerships, and creator campaigns.

The ideal candidate combines deep fluency in the Fortnite creator ecosystem with strong strategic judgment, communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. This person should understand both gaming culture and broader entertainment ecosystems, and be equally comfortable building creator strategy, managing high-profile talent relationships, and navigating complex cross-functional initiatives.

In this role, you will

  • Develop and lead creator and influencer strategies tied to Fortnite launches, partnerships, live-service beats, and major campaigns
  • Translate brand and business objectives into measurable creator programs that drive audience engagement, conversation, and commercial impact
  • Build and manage relationships with key gaming creators, streamers, athletes, entertainers, agents, and talent representatives across multiple verticals
  • Lead high-profile creator and talent integrations from planning through execution, including negotiations, hospitality, experiential activations, and content coordination
  • Present creator strategies, talent recommendations, and campaign plans clearly and concisely to senior leadership
  • Partner cross-functionally across Paid Media, Brand Marketing, Competitive, IP Partnerships teams and external partners to deliver cohesive global campaigns
  • Manage agency partners and oversee campaign execution to ensure work meets Epic’s creative, operational, and business standards

PROGRAMMING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of programming experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We are seeking an experienced Lead Gameplay Programmer to direct gameplay teams within Rocket League. They will be responsible for leading the gameplay programming team and collaborating and iterating with gameplay programmers, game designers, producers, and artists. They will play a critical role in feature development for Rocket League.

In this role, you will

  • Manage a team of seasoned gameplay programmers and be the primary hub of communication and information for other disciplines
  • Distill high-level feature requests into meaningful, actionable work items and delegate effectively to the team
  • Deliver core gameplay features efficiently and on time, and speak up when the team is overor under-scoped
  • Lead the vision for different gameplay systems and features and write code and do system design as needed
  • Propose and review technical design, systems, and technical approaches to ensure that they satisfy requirements and promote a healthy codebase
  • Work closely with art and design leads to ensure gameplay mechanics meet functional requirements and uphold our high standards
  • Work closely with other programming disciplines to integrate systems in support of the player experience

What we're looking for

  • Experience developing gameplay physics systems (simulation, collision, character/vehicle physics, etc.)
  • Experience with network replication systems (client-server prediction, state synchronization, lag compensation)
  • Proven track record delivering live-service games or AAA MMO titles built on Unreal Engine
  • Proven leadership experience managing high-performing programming teams on shipped AAA titles
  • Strong C++ skills and the ability to code and design gameplay mechanics and tools
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, as well

ART

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Lead Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement to join our team. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to Fortnite and other initiatives as part of our collaboration with Disney. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact cosmetic assets and gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production
  • Communicate and drive alignment around strategy for technical animation and adjacent cosmetics teams
  • Work with production to schedule, prioritize, and delegate assets for the team, both internal and vendor
  • Work closely with animators, modelers, and designers to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets
  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Mentor rigging-focused technical animators
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

  • Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products
  • Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance
  • Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms
  • Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

  • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
    • Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
    • Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling
    • Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
  • Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

jobs.title: Principal Animator
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Principal Animator to join our Fortnite team and help shape the future of gameplay animation. In this highly influential, hands-on role, you'll create exceptional keyframed gameplay animation, build playable prototypes that explore new ideas for Fortnite, and help develop innovative animation techniques, tools, and emerging workflows. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in gameplay animation, strong creative and technical instincts, and a passion for exploring AI-assisted animation technologies. You'll collaborate across disciplines to elevate animation quality, explore new gameplay possibilities, and help define the next generation of animation workflows within Fortnite.

In this role, you will

  • Own gameplay animation from initial concept through implementation in Unreal Engine 5, with a focus on gameplay feel, responsiveness, style, and visual appeal
  • Independently come up with new gameplay ideas, build playable prototypes, and iterate on them through playtesting. Bring a strong sense of what makes Fortnite fun and where there's room to take it in new directions
  • Champion AI-assisted animation technologies and emerging workflows, identifying opportunities to enhance animation quality, creativity, and production efficiency
  • Experiment with, prototype, and help integrate innovative animation tools and techniques into Fortnite's animation pipelines
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in gameplay animation, providing creative and technical direction across teams while remaining deeply hands-on
  • Partner closely with Design, Engineering, Technical Animation, Technical Design, and Production to solve complex animation challenges and influence long-term animation strategies
  • Establish best practices, mentor animators, and raise the bar for animation quality, technical execution, and workflow innovation
  • Create and refine stylized and realistic gameplay animation in Unreal Engine 5 using Control Rig and Animation Blueprints

What You'll Do

You'll be the senior technical voice across Epic's developer platform: the source control, CI/CD, build, artifact, database and cloud infrastructure that teams across Epic use to build and ship their work. You'll look at problems across systems and teams, and set the technical strategy for where the platform needs to go. The primary focus of this role is rebuilding and scaling our systems to handle millions of agentic CICD actions per day. You'll work across teams to understand their requirements and usage patterns, negotiate trade-offs with cost and feasibility in mind, and build and deploy the changes needed. Beyond that, this is a role for someone we can point at a hard, ambiguous problem in any domain or team and trust to understand it, decide what to do, and get it solved, whether that means designing the system and building it yourself, or bringing the right people together. Epic is an agentic-programming-first company. You'll be expected to use Al coding tools and agents as a normal part of how you work, and help shape how we apply them to our own infrastructure.

jobs.title: Product Management Director, FamXP
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

TRUST AND SAFETY

What We Do

The Epic Trust and Safety team provides a safer experience for Epic users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

FamXP, the Family Experience team within Trust, Safety, and Support, is responsible for the safety, privacy, and age-appropriate experience of kids and families across Epic's products. We ship features for kids and parents, review product updates across the company for safety and privacy considerations, collaborate with legal to translate regulatory requirements to an actionable product roadmap, and provide insights to our partner teams grounded in primary research we conduct with parents and players. This Product Management Director role will own complex, cross-product initiatives on the FamXP roadmap, set priorities for the FamXP team, and set the standard for how the FamXP product team operates.

In this role, you will

  • Drive FamXP initiatives from strategy through design, build, and launch, in partnership with engineering, QA, design, legal, policy, and analytics counterparts across multiple Epic product surfaces
  • Keep priorities clear, dependencies visible, and teams moving on what matters most
  • Develop and communicate FamXP strategy to the executive audience
  • Define metrics that matter, strengthen instrumentation where the signal is weak, and guide the team to ground decisions in data
  • Navigate a fast-evolving global regulatory landscape, partnering closely with legal and policy to translate new obligations into product deliverables (often on tight timelines)

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-product, or platform initiatives
  • Direct, hands-on experience partnering with legal, regulatory, or compliance teams, ideally in a regulated industry
  • Structured thinker who can bring clarity and momentum to an ambiguous problem space
  • Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable representing strategy and trade-offs to executive stakeholders
  • Quantitative thinker who drives visibility into product performance

jobs.title: Release Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a quality-focused Senior Release Manager to work closely with our producers, programmers, build engineers, and QA teams to oversee the build and release process for the Fortnite Ecosystem. In this position, you will work directly with the brightest technical minds in the business as we build the premier game engine for a multitude of platforms.

In this role, you will

  • Develop new practices and structures to better scale release management and stabilization processes across our Game Dev ecosystem, while managing a sub-team of release managers
  • Own the scheduling, coordination, quality control, and external certification process across multiple platforms and/or products
  • Act as the liaison between multiple development teams, coordinating and negotiating development plans, exceptions, sales/mktg/publishing content, as well as releases
  • Work with the publishing and development teams to determine release content plans as related to sales, giveaways, promotions, etc., and shepherd that content through external party approvals for release
  • Work closely with QA, Build Engineers, and Lead Programmers to monitor the automated build and integration process, facilitate the resolution of build failures, and understand and communicate the impact of branches and code merges
  • Partner with QA Leads to establish and maintain the bug triage process and prioritize must-fix issues, coordinate internal and external release notes, known issues, and knowledge base updates, and ensure releases have passed all required checks and approvals leading up to live deployment, while communicating approved exceptions to all necessary parties

What we're looking for

  • Strong production/project management skills, communication skills, and people management/direct report experience
  • Demonstrated ability in right-sized process development and improvement

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ONLINE INFRASTRUCTURE

What We Do

We enable Epic’s online services teams to build, deploy, and manage services that are used by more than half a billion players around the world. Our mission is to provide world class tools and platforms to improve the experience of our developers and make it easier, faster, and safer to build, operate, and scale their applications. We operate at massive scale as one of the largest cloud computing users in the world.

What You'll Do

You'll own the backend systems behind Epic's CI/CD and build tooling and the cloud infrastructure they run on. These systems carry code from commit to production for teams across Epic, so they need to be fast, reliable and secure. Your primary focus is software supply chain security: securing the pipelines, runners and artifact stores that build and ship our software, working closely with our security and governance teams. This is a hands-on technical lead role. You'll spend most of your time building and running systems yourself, while helping set the team's technical direction, architecture and goals. Epic is an agentic-engineering-first company. You'll be expected to use Al coding tools and agents as a normal part of how you work, and help shape how we apply them to our own infrastructure.

In this role, you will

  • Design, build and operate the backend infrastructure for our CI/CD and artifact platforms on AWS and GCP
  • Lead software supply chain security work, including vulnerability scanning, artifact signing and provenance, and hardening of build runners and agents
  • Partner with security and governance teams on controls, audits and compliance requirements, and turn them into practical changes to tools and pipelines
  • Help set technical direction for the platform: weigh in on design, priorities and longer-term goals, and document the decisions
  • Guide and review the work of a team of contractors, setting clear tasks and standards and keeping the work moving
  • Automate wherever possible, with infrastructure as code, self-service tooling and workflows that reduce manual work
  • Improve the reliability, scale and observability of the build platform, troubleshoot hard production issues, and take part in incident response

jobs.title: Senior Communications Manager, Corporate
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

COMMUNICATIONS

What We Do

The Epic Communications team advances the company’s narrative and represents Epic products and the company vision to external and internal audiences globally. We create positive relationships and engagement strategies with a wide range of audiences, including media, investors, influencers, and policymakers.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for an experienced communications professional to join our corporate communications and international team. In this role you will create and execute communications plans around high stakes policy, legal and regulatory developments, that impact Epic and the video game industry at large.

In this role, you will

  • Create proactive and reactive communications strategies on priority policy, regulatory and legal developments, such as online safety
  • Partner with the public policy team on impactful public affairs campaigns globally to build understanding of and support for our products and safety approaches
  • Partner with Epic’s Trust and Safety team on storytelling around our industry-leading approach to online safety and product features
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop proactive storytelling opportunities around Epic’s business, products, and technology in Latin America and Canada
  • Educate external stakeholders including third parties and media about Epic’s public policy and regulatory priorities
  • Establish and maintain relationships with journalists globally including technology, business and policy media on behalf of Epic
  • Be part of the team that manages Epic’s rapid response efforts, working in fast-paced environments to address issues with players, consumers, and policy makers

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in communications or public relations, preferably a mix of in-house and agency and/or political organizations
  • Experience driving communications and advocacy strategies around complex public policy issues
  • Experience working on rapid response with internal stakeholders
  • Experience managing global agency partners
  • Someone who moves fast, is focused on delivering results, and has a track record of working well across a diverse group of internal and external partners</

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

Epic’s regulatory team advises the company on newly enacted laws and regulations around the world as well as works alongside our Public Policy Team to monitor regulatory developments.   • Experience turning legal, policy, or regulatory language into precise metric definitions, documented well enough for someone else to audit

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

jobs.title: Senior Engine Programmer, Verse Framework
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Verse Framework Integration team is bringing the next major iteration of Unreal Engine to life, enabling creators to build the next generation of interactive experiences. You'll play a central role connecting many aspects of the engine, helping shape how Verse integrates with core engine systems.

In this role, you will

  • Design and implement low-level engine systems across Scene Graph, networking, analytics, and the language toolchain, with a focus on robustness, performance, and usability
  • Design stable, forward-thinking APIs that expose engine capabilities through Verse, for both internal and external developers
  • Collaborate across core engine and other framework teams as well as the Verse language team to build solutions that meet diverse and evolving needs
  • Help shape and unlock the capabilities of Verse within Unreal Engine
  • Drive technical excellence across platforms, including debugging, optimization, and system reliability

What we're looking for

  • Expert level C++ skills with the ability to design game engine systems and associated tools
  • Experience creating and maintaining APIs with exceptionally strong backward compatibility requirements
  • Diverse experience with and enthusiasm for applying that same backward compatibility rigor to stored data: serialization formats, schema evolution, and safely migrating live player data
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to find solutions beyond established approaches
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating with teams to define deliverables
  • Comfortable working in any low level engine system, even those outside of your comfort zone
  • Experience with multiple programming languages and a track record of leveraging their strengths effectively
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience writing performant code across multiple hardware platforms, including game consoles

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, engineering, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on game systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

  • Work in close collaboration with project leads & directors to design, prototype, tune, and ship features and systems that support the engagement, gameplay, and creative vision of the project
  • Document and create clear, actionable design documents, and iterate on these features, working with a team of developers across multiple disciplines, and oversee their successful implementation from start to finish
  • Get hands-on creating the scripting, data, and content required by those features, diving into the engine, and leveraging other tools
  • Be responsible for soliciting and rapidly integrating feedback from across the team on your own initiative, ensuring we’re continually delivering a fun and fresh experience to our players
  • Help establish and maintain design pipelines, best practices, and cross-discipline communication standards to scope, prioritize deliverables, and hit milestone goals

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
  • Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System
  • Demonst

In this role, you will

  • Own the design and hands-on implementation of music-based gameplay features and systems, including using Jam Tracks, music interaction mechanics, and social music experiences, while fostering innovation
  • Effectively communicate project vision to team members across all disciplines, collaborating closely with audio, engineering, art, UX, and product teams to ensure compelling player experiences and overall ecosystem health
  • Set and maintain high-quality standards for music gameplay and social interaction design, actively participating in big-picture decisions to drive superior results
  • Create clear, structured design documents and drive collaborative, iterative prototyping processes to rapidly explore and refine music systems, player interactions, and emergent gameplay opportunities
  • Design and tune systems that support music gameplay, progression, discovery, and player expression, leveraging data and playtest feedback to react quickly to changing project needs and drive effective solutions
  • Partner closely with audio and engineering teams to develop intuitive tools and mechanics that empower players to create, remix, and engage with music-driven experiences

What we're looking for

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience shipping multiple titles as a game designer, with expertise in systems design and multiplayer gameplay, ideally including music gameplay, rhythm mechanics, social experiences, and player expression features

jobs.title: Senior Graphics Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Fortnite Desktop team is seeking an experienced Senior Rendering Engineer to enhance the player experience on PC. You will work with other engineers and directly contribute to building and improving our Desktop platform support to an industry-leading state.

This role is the perfect opportunity to work on the rendering systems that power Fortnite's visuals. You will improve existing features and systems and design new ones to ensure the best player experience across a wide variety of hardware and software configurations.

In this role, you will

  • Analyze and resolve stability and performance problems of Fortnite on a wide range of PC hardware configurations; this includes identifying solutions in such areas as:
    • Solving device-specific CPU and GPU performance and compatibility issues
    • Rendering performance and device compatibility, including the shader pipeline
    • Improving rendering systems and optimizing their stability and performance across various graphics APIs
    • Improvements in low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e., memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, and input systems
  • Monitor stability and performance data from Fortnite releases and improve Unreal Engine’s systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases

  • Solid grounding in software engineering principles, including API design
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver practical solutions

What We Do

Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.

What You'll Do

You will design, build, and optimize the recommendation systems that power Fortnite's Discover experience, serving personalized recommendations to one of the largest player bases in gaming across a massive catalog of creator-built experiences.

You'll work across the full recommendation stack: candidate generation, content ranking, impression allocation, and real-time reranking.

Unlike recommendation systems that operate over a stable catalog, you're working with a massive, rapidly changing content library where new experiences are published daily, quality signals are sparse, and the system's own outputs shape the data it learns from.

  • Design and implement retrieval, ranking, and reranking models for creator content using deep learning approaches (two-tower architectures, transformer-based sequence models, embedding-based retrieval) and build the user representation systems that power personalized discovery
  • Build and optimize multi-stage candidate generation and impression allocation pipelines that balance relevance, diversity, and fair content exposure across a large and rapidly evolving catalog

  • Collaborate with analytics and content quality teams on ranking signals including genre classification, creator credibility, and content quality metrics
  • Own ML infrastructure decisions: choosing the right tradeoffs between batch, near-real-time, and streaming serving architectures

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

The Fortnite Desktop team is seeking an experienced Senior Rendering Engineer to enhance the player experience on PC. You will work with other engineers and directly contribute to building and improving our Desktop platform support to an industry-leading state.

This role is the perfect opportunity to work on the rendering systems that power Fortnite's visuals. You will improve existing features and systems and design new ones to ensure the best player experience across a wide variety of hardware and software configurations.

In this role, you will

  • Analyze and resolve stability and performance problems of Fortnite on a wide range of PC hardware configurations; this includes identifying solutions in such areas as:
    • Solving device-specific CPU and GPU performance and compatibility issues
    • Rendering performance and device compatibility, including the shader pipeline
    • Improving rendering systems and optimizing their stability and performance across various graphics APIs
    • Improvements in low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e., memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, and input systems
  • Monitor stability and performance data from Fortnite releases and improve Unreal Engine’s systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Work with GPU vendors and other partners to resolve technical issues and collaborate on improving underlying technologies, such as graphics drivers for Fortnite and Unreal Engine
  • Assess performance data across various hardware and improve Unreal Engine’s rendering systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Collaborate with a variety of other Epic teams, such as Unreal Engine’s Rendering Architecture team, to help them solve complex technical challenges in ways that move the stability and quality of Fortnite and our internal products forward

What we're looking for

  • Strong C++ knowledge and multi-thread

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

INFOSEC

What We Do

Keep Epic’s networks, hardware, and people safe from security risks. Install security measures and operate software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and encryption programs. Document issues as they arise and assess & report any impact caused.

What You'll Do

InfoSec at Epic is rethinking how security gets done, replacing manual processes with automated, Al-driven systems that scale with the business. As a senior engineer reporting directly to InfoSec leadership, you will design and build the platforms that define the future of security engineering at Epic, turning hard problems into reliable, enterprise-grade solutions that teams across the company depend on.

In this role, you will

  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities to automate security operations, then independently design, build, and ship the solution end to end
  • Architect and deliver enterprise-scale platforms and services (detection and response pipelines, asset and software inventory, risk and exception workflows) that are adopted well beyond InfoSec
  • Build and harden Al-agent workflows that take on recurring security work, with the validation, auditability, and guardrails needed to trust them in production
  • Integrate security tooling, cloud platforms, and internal data sources into cohesive systems with clean APIs and clear ownership
  • Challenge established ways of working, prototype quickly with emerging technologies, and turn successful experiments into durable, maintainable products
  • Partner with security, platform, and engineering teams to drive adoption and raise the engineering bar through code review, mentorship, and shared standards
  • Own the reliability of what you build, including observability, documentation, and a clear path for long-term support

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating distributed systems or platforms at enterprise scale
  • Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C#, with a track record of shipping production-quality

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

ENGINEERING - EPIC GAMES SERVICES

What We Do

Driving the plug-in power behind Unreal Engine 5. We bridge connections for licensees and our own internal game teams to online services. This allows games like Fortnite to utilize a combination of platform online services as well as Epic’s own online services to build cross-platform online features. Login, parties, voice chat, matchmaking, purchasing, cloud storage, and analytics are just a few examples of online features that our Online Game Services team helps games utilize.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Security Engineer focused on Application Security to develop and improve our services, products, and games against exploits and attacks. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate would have prior experience developing security features. We are particularly interested in those that have prior experience working with desktop application security or Unreal Engine. This is an incredible opportunity to create a safe environment for millions of players and advance industry best practices.

In this role, you will

  • Collaborate with the Fortnite and Unreal Engine teams to understand the security implications of existing and upcoming features, proposing changes if appropriate

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Senior Tech Artist to join our team working on Fortnite Events. A successful candidate should have a deep knowledge in look development, lighting and complex game art. A successful candidate should have a broad knowledge of art creation for games. You should understand modeling, texturing, and animation fundamentals. You should be able to combine geometry, materials, effects, and UE Blueprints to create complex art. You should be able to work with both internal ICs, leads and directors as well as direct vendors to support the more technical aspects of creating art.

In this role, you will

  • Create complex materials for landscape and environments
  • Be responsible for world lighting, sets lighting, clouds, atmospherics, water lookdev
  • Execute on a range of visual styles with emphasis on stylized with a high level of fidelity
  • Work with engineers and artists to optimize content for many platforms
  • Own gameplay and engine features from the TechArt side maintaining the high-quality bar for Fortnite Events

What we're looking for

  • Must have a strong reel/portfolio showing executed game tech art
  • Experienced knowledge of PBR principles and material editors
  • Establish workflows and tools for other artists to utilize when making unique assets
  • Experience using texturing packagers such as Substance Designer
  • High level of proficiency in setting up world environmental lighting
  • Desire and knowledge of how to push Unreal Engine further
  • Desire to work with a team and own features and initiatives from inception to ship
  • Familiarity with the Unreal 5 Engine art pipeline
  • Experience working on multiple platforms
  • Scripting experience Blueprint or other

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA).

jobs.title: Laser Architect - Beam Smoothing
jobs.description:
Summary 
We are looking for a Senior Laser Architect to take ownership of beam-smoothing technology within our laser-driven fusion programme. You will work in the Laser Division to connect smoothing performance with science requirements and laser system design, so that beam quality and system reliability support our fusion energy goals.

Key responsibilities

Own the beam-smoothing roadmap, from concept through deployment and continuous improvement.

Translate science and system requirements into beam-smoothing and laser-system specifications.

Guide the design and optimisation of smoothing approaches for uniformity, contrast and focal-spot quality, across coherent and incoherent techniques.

Assess how smoothing choices affect the wider laser and facility architecture, balancing performance, complexity, risk and cost.

Work with modelling, experimental and engineering teams to turn results into design decisions.

Support technology selection and supplier engagement for smoothing-related hardware and diagnostics.

Set design standards and provide technical direction and mentoring to the beam-smoothing team.

Required qualifications

PhD or equivalent experience in physics, optics, photonics, applied physics, electrical engineering or a related field.

Significant hands-on experience with high-power or high-energy laser systems, in research or industry.

Solid understanding of beam smoothing and beam quality, including coherence, speckle, propagation and focal-spot formation.

Experience designing and analysing experiments on laser performance or beam quality.

Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and translating physics needs into engineering requirements.

Preferred qualifications

Experience with laser-driven fusion or inertial confinement fusion programmes.

Experience with modelling tools for beam propagation and smoothing.

Familiarity with systems engineering practices such as requirements flow-down, verification and trade studies.

Experience working with vendors on optical components or beam-conditioning hardware.

Personal attributes

Strong systems thinking, with the ability to weigh trade-offs between smoothing, efficiency, reliability and facility performance.

Clear communicator, able to turn complex physics into decisions.

Collaborative, hands-on approach.

Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

Works closely with:  laser architects, systems engineering, target physics, diagnostics, controls, operations and external partners.

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.  We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.  We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.  As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define.

What you'll do

Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard  Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room  Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery  Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand  Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products

Requirements

Two things matter most:  Taste. You have a distinct eye and a strong point of view, and you can build a visual world that looks like nobody else's. Everything you make feels considered, right down to the type.  Thinking. You start from the idea. You can take a strategy and a belief and turn them into a system with a reason behind every choice, and you can explain those reasons in plain words to anyone in the company.  Beyond that, we want someone with deep craft in typography, colour and composition, who has built or evolved an identity system that went live in the real world, and who moves fast without letting quality slip. We expect you to have 5+ years experience, ideally at a top studio or on an in-house team at a brand people admire. Motion, 3D or packaging experience is a bonus.

Benefits

Competitive salary and eligibility for equity  Biannual bonus scheme  Fully expensed tech to match your needs  Private health insurance  Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

jobs.title: Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d), 6 Months — ALPAMI  Location: Munich (HQ), with regular visits to our properties and development sites Reports to: Founders / Managing Director Type: Full-time internship, 6 months, starting January/February 2027, ideally as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum)  About ALPAMI  At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 250+ units across four countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy. Our focus is the outdoors, with Tiny Houses and Cabins in nature, while our City Boutique Houses are our flagships. We also run Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.  We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast with a clear target of 500+ units 2027. That means there is more to build, analyse and decide than our founders can handle alone, and that's exactly where you come in.  The Role  We're looking for a Founders Associate intern who works side by side with our founders for six months and takes work off their desk, whatever it is. One week you're finding and qualifying new sites for our Tiny Houses, the next you're building the financial model for a new location or visiting a construction site, and in between you make sure our books are in order. You'll see every part of a growing hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations.  This is a hands-on role. You won't just prepare slides for others to act on. You'll own projects from the first analysis to the first guest, and you'll use AI to get there faster: we're looking for someone who builds with AI, not someone who only writes texts with it. If you want to learn how a hospitality company is built from the inside and take on real responsibility early, this is it.  What You'll Do

Source new sites with AI - find and qualify plots, municipalities, campsites and landowners for our Tiny Houses and prepare the first outreach. Sites are our biggest bottleneck, so this is your core task

Analyse deals - screen and evaluate new properties, sites and management mandates, and prepare investment memos and decision papers for the founders

Build financial models - business cases, budgets, financing and rent scenarios for new projects and existing properties

Support our expansion - market and location research, preparation of investor and partner meetings, pitch materials, data rooms and documents for investors and banks

Support our Tiny House developments - work with manufacturers, landowners, authorities and contractors, keep track of permits, budgets and timelines, and accompany site visits from groundwork to the first guest

Help finding the right operational partners and calculate and negotiate terms

Support bookkeeping tasks - manage invoices and receipts, prepare documents for our tax advisors, track costs and keep the liquidity overview up to date

Own founder projects - from contract preparation and process setup

jobs.title: [AI Transformation Dept.] Sr. AI Transformation Specialist (7년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

"현장의 가장 깊숙한 곳에 투입되어, AI로 비즈니스 병목을 파괴하는 스페셜리스트"

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여 임직원들의 일하는 방식(Work & Workflow)을 혁신하는 핵심 조직입니다.

현업(게임 제작 스튜디오, 글로벌 퍼블리싱, 백오피스 등)의 한가운데로 직접 투입되어, 그들이 겪는 치명적인 비즈니스 Pain Point를 발굴하고 AI 기술을 통해 즉각적인 솔루션을 만들어냅니다. 전사 AI 해커톤을 이끌고, 최단 시간 내에 MVP(최소 기능 제품)를 런칭하여 '기술이 어떻게 재무적/시간적 성과로 이어지는지'를 현장에서 직접 증명해 낼 강인하고 속도감 있는 Transformation Specialist을 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • AI 혁신 전략 수립 및 자문: 현업 부서의 비즈니스 과제를 분석하여 AI 적용 전략을 독자적으로 수립하고, 기술적 방향성 및 우선순위에 대한 전문적 자문 제시
  • 비즈니스 요구사항 분석 및 아키텍처 설계: 비개발 직군(기획, 재무, HR 등)의 복잡한 요구사항을 정확히 분석·해석하고, 이를 AI 기반의 아키텍처로 설계 및 구현
  • AI 기술 도입 타당성 연구 및 ROI 분석: 도입된 AI 기술의 실제 비용 절감 및 업무 시간 단축 효과를 정량적으로 분석·연구하고, 성공 사례를 전사 스케일업(Scale-up) 전략으로 기획
  • 현업 밀착형 AI 프로토타이핑 및 해커톤 기획: 현업 부서와 직접 호흡하며 비즈니스 문제를 정의하고, 단기간(며칠~몇 주) 내에 AI 에이전트 및 자동화 앱을 설계·프로토타이핑하여 기술 검증 수행 (사내 AI 해커톤 등 전사 혁신 이니셔티브 기술 총괄 포함)

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 관련 분야 7년 이상의 전문 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 실무 경력을 바탕으로, 개발 팀이나 목적 조직(TF)을 리딩하여 프로젝트를 성공적으로 완수한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 프론트엔드부터 백엔드까지 (Full-stack) 폭넓은 개발 이해도를 바탕으로, 요구사항 분석부터 프로토타입 런칭까지의 전체 사이클을 독자적으로 기획·설계하고 빠르게 실행할 수 있는

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane — the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. Our platform consists of two core components: a capacity reservation engine managing guaranteed GPU reservations and their lifecycle, including rebalancing and auto-reclamation logic; and a Quotas Control Plane that manages quotas across all Nebius services, handles customer quota requests, and runs the algorithms that distribute resources. Both are exposed through APIs that give external customers, internal users, and downstream services visibility and control over their limits.
This is a high-ownership role. You will define how Capacity and Quota Management matures, from the technical foundations to the tradeoffs that outlast any single feature.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong knowledge of Python or willingness to quickly become productive with our technology stack

  • Experience building distributed backend systems and microservice architectures

  • Understanding of distributed transactions, consistency models, and reliable asynchronous workflows

  • Strong communication and ownership mindset

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

Du entwickelst skalierbare Systeme, triffst belastbare Entscheidungen zur Softwarearchitektur und nutzt Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder vergleichbare Coding Agents als produktive Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag.

Deine Aufgaben:

Du gestaltest anspruchsvolle Backend-Lösungen von der technischen Idee bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Dabei übernimmst Du Ownership für Softwarearchitektur, APIs, Datenmodelle und Integrationen und hast echten Einfluss auf Technologieentscheidungen und Entwicklungsstandards.

Sehr gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einer etablierten Backend-Technologie, beispielsweise Python, Java, C#, TypeScript oder Node.js, ergänzt um einen sicheren Umgang mit Git und CI/CD-Workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Motion & VFX Designer (gn)
jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

💡 👉 Hinweis: Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung.

WAS DU MACHST

Du entwickelst und animierst Video-Ads und Social-Formate in After Effects — von der Typo-Animation bis zur komplexen, mehrschichtigen Szene — und bringst sie in Premiere Pro in einen Schnitt, der werblich funktioniert.

Du kombinierst gefilmtes Material mit generierten Elementen: Freistellen, Rotoskopieren, Tracken, Keyen, bis der Übergang unsichtbar ist.

Du setzt generative Tools dort ein, wo sie das Ergebnis besser oder schneller machen, und weißt, wo ihre Grenzen liegen: Konsistenz über Sequenzen, Typografie, Markendarstellung. Die Workflows dafür baust du selbst.

Du gibst Impulse ins Team — neue Techniken, Tools, Workflows — und zeigst Kolleg:innen, wie sie funktionieren.

Du arbeitest eng mit Performance, Kreation und Produktion zusammen und sagst früh, wenn ein Briefing so nicht umsetzbar ist oder anders besser wird.

Stellenanforderungen

WAS DU BRAUCHST

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Motion Designer:in auf Senior-Level. After Effects beherrschst du bis in komplexe Animationen: Keyframing, Expressions, Typo-Animation gehören zu deinem Alltag.

Compositing ist für dich Handwerk, nicht Ausnahme: Rotoskopie, Tracking, Keying und die saubere Integration generierter oder gefilmter Elemente in Footage.

Sicherer Schnitt in Premiere Pro mit Gespür für Timing und Dramaturgie werblicher Formate.

Ein bis drei reale Projekte, in denen du generative Video- oder Bildtools oder AI-Compositing-Workflows eingesetzt hast. Wir fragen danach im Gespräch und wollen die Arbeit sehen.

Du bringst dich von selbst ein, teilst Wissen und wartest nicht auf Aufträge, um Dinge zu verbessern.

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Ein Plus, kein Muss
3D in Blender oder Cinema 4D · Colorgrading in DaVinci oder Lumetri · Grundlagen im Sound Design

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

Onboarding & Support 
No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns.

jobs.description:
Your mission

We’re looking for you!

TikTok Shop is changing the way people shop online – and you can be part of it from the very beginning.

GENUINE is one of Germany’s leading TikTok Shop partners, and we’re looking for a  Shop Manager (m/f/d)  to join our team in Cologne. You’ll own the operational performance of some of our most important TikTok Shops – making sure prices are live, campaigns are registered, ads are running, stock is available, and every shop is set up to grow.

Your mission:  turn commercial strategy into flawless execution.  You’ll work closely with our Growth and Creator teams, manage everything happening inside Seller Center, and use performance and profitability data to identify the next growth opportunities.

Join one of Europe’s most sought-after TikTok Shop agencies and take ownership of the engine behind high-performing TikTok Shops.

Shop Ownership:  You take operational ownership of a selection of our core TikTok Shops – ensuring pricing, promotions, campaigns, listings, stock, and overall shop health are always on track.

Pricing & Promotions:  You implement pricing and promotional strategies in Seller Center and identify the best mechanics – from platform coupons and flash deals to product discounts, bundles, and campaign entries.

Campaign Management:  You register products and shops for TikTok campaigns, deals, and platform programs, ensuring deadlines and eligibility requirements are met.

Performance & Profitability:  You analyze performance at product, campaign, and account level – understanding what drives GMV, what actually generates margin, and where the next growth opportunity sits.

Ads & Boosting:  You set up and optimize TikTok Shop ad campaigns, manage budgets and bidding, and boost high-performing creator content and creator live streams.

Stock & Forecasting:  You monitor inventory and forecast demand based on promotions, campaigns, and creator activity – identifying potential out-of-stock risks before they impact performance.

Shop Health:  You monitor ratings, fulfillment, service indicators, and platform violations, taking action before issues affect shop performance.

Growth Opportunities:  You turn data into action – identifying underpriced SKUs, untapped campaign opportunities, categories with additional potential, and new TikTok Shop features worth adopting.

Your profile

Initial experience in  e-commerce, marketplace management, performance marketing, commercial operations, or account management  – ideally in a fast-paced environment.

You’re highly analytical and comfortable working with  KPIs, profitability, pricing, and performance data  – but you also know how to turn insights into action.

Strong commercial understanding: You understand how  pricing, discounts, advertising, stock, and promotions  interact and impact both GMV and profitability.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a  Product Engineer (m/f/d)  to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step.

This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen.

Your Mission

End-to-End Product Delivery:  Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing.

Product Thinking & User Focus:  Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt.

Building AI into Products:  Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities.

Data Modelling & Scalable Systems:  Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption:  Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation.

Continuous Improvement:  Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive.

Nice to Have:

Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.

Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar).

Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption.

Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).

Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments.

jobs.title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt.

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben.

Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz.

Was dich erwartet

Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases.

Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap.

Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase.

Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit.

Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact.

Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales.

Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen.

Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle.

Das solltest du mitbringen

Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.

Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus.

Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.

Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken.

Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher
