jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Short Description

SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce, and recognized with the SPARK AI Innovation Award and a place among LinkedIn's Top Startups in DACH.

Role 
In this role, you sit inside the Founders' Office and work on the decisions that set SPREAD's direction. You own the strategy cycle and translate it into company goals and OKRs; you drive the strategic and improvement initiatives that come out of it, and you run the operating rhythm that keeps the leadership team deciding and the company executing. Alongside that, you own SPREAD's ecosystem of partners and senior industry advisors. You shape how the whole company hears about strategy through the monthly Assembly, and you build the material founders and the leadership team decide on. You report to the VP Strategy & Finance and work daily with the founders, the leadership team, and the people delivering the outcomes you help define.

Your Mission

Own the strategy cycle from analysis through to a written strategy the leadership team commits to, then translate it into company OKRs, goals, and the quarterly review rhythm that keeps every team measured against them.

Drive strategic and improvement initiatives end to end. Recent examples include improving our cross-functional delivery model, leveling up our performance management system, building out our competitor intelligence, and rolling AI agents out company-wide.

Run the operating rhythm of the leadership team across the weekly leadership meeting, monthly workshops, and half-year offsites. Set the agenda, prepare the discussions and decisions, and track every decision and task.

Own the monthly company Assembly, from storyline to deck, so every team leaves knowing where SPREAD stands, where we are going, and what it means for their work.

Build and steer SPREAD's partner ecosystem across hyperscalers, systems integrators, strategy consultancies, and tech companies, and convert those relationships into commercial opportunities, co-marketing and integrated offerings.

Manage SPREAD's portfolio of senior industry advisors, former executives from the automotive and defense industry, to generate commercial opportunities and capture deep industry insights and expertise.

Step into selected high-stakes commercial opportunities and ongoing engagements alongside Sales, Product, Value Realization, and Engineering, bringing structure and pace.

Prepare investor materials and board reporting across fundraising rounds and quarterly cycles.

Your Experience

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Manager:in
jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...

Deine Mission:  Als Trade Marketing Manager:in

bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel . Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Deine Rolle:

Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.

Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.

Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).

Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.

Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.

Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.

Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

Purpose:  Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.

Impact  vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.

Echtes Startup Teamgefühl:  Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.

Teamlunch : Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer  eigenen  vly-Köchin!

Mobilität und Company Fitness:  Zus

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt.

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Bei uns erwartet dich ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe - ohne Hierarchien.

Für unseren Bereich Forward Deployed Engineering suchen wir dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht empfiehlt, sondern baut, deployt und in Produktion verantwortet.

Was dich erwartet

Forward Deployed heißt bei uns: Du bist Beobachter, Architekt und Entwickler in einer Person. Dieselbe Person, die das Problem beim Kunden versteht, schreibt den Code, der es löst - und bleibt, bis es produktiv läuft.

End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Deployments von der Discovery über technisches Scoping, Architektur und Build bis zum Produktions-Rollout in der Infrastruktur des Kunden - eingebettet in dessen Engineering- und Fachteams.

Full-Stack, wörtlich gemeint: Du arbeitest über alle Schichten - Model-Serving (vLLM, eigene GPU-Cluster), Agent-Gateways und Runtimes, RAG-/GraphRAG-Pipelines, spezialisierte Agenten, Integration in ERP, CRM, DMS und Legacy-Systeme.

Auf erprobtem Fundament: Du deployst und erweiterst unsere Produkt-Stacks (mAIstack, VoiceAI, Amicable) beim Kunden, statt jedes Projekt bei null zu beginnen – mit LLMs wie GPT, Gemini, Claude oder Nemotron, Agent-Frameworks und agentischen Harnesses. Vector-Datenbanken und RAG sind dabei Handwerkszeug; als Senior sorgst du dafür, dass die Systeme im Betrieb messbar und beherrschbar bleiben – über Dataset-basierte Evaluations, Logging/Tracing und Observability.

Der Rückfluss ist Teil des Jobs: Was sich im Feld als wiederkehrendes Muster erweist, kodifizierst du mit deinem Team in unseren Produkten, Skills und Playbooks. Dein Projektwissen bleibt nicht beim Kunden liegen - es macht das nächste Deployment schneller.

Kunde auf Augenhöhe: Du entwickelst in Workshops ein gemeinsames Bild von Problem, Chancen und Lösung, triffst Trade-off-Entscheidungen zwischen Scope, Tempo und Qualität - und sprichst auch an, was der Kunde nicht hören will, wenn es das Ergebnis schützt.

Sichtbarkeit: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen in Whitepaper, Talks und unsere AI-Produkte ein - mit Unterstützung unserer technischen Redaktion.

Das solltest du mitbringen

Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.

Du hast LLM-Systeme in Produktion gebracht - nicht nur prototypisiert: RAG-Implementierungen, Vector Databases, Agent-Frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK o. ä.), Evals und MLOps.

Erfahrung mit der Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende, gewachsene Enterprise-Architekturen - inklusive der unbequemen Teile (Auth, Legacy, Compliance).

Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Inference-Infrastruktur (vLLM, GPU-Serving), Kubernetes und On-Prem-/Private-Cloud-Deployments.

Die Kompetenz, AI-Konzepte

jobs.description:
Location

Frankfurt am Main

About Us

About AllUnity

AllUnity is a regulated e-money institute building Europe’s digital payments infrastructure for instant cross-border payments, digital asset markets, and seamless liquidity flows. Established by DWS, Flow Traders, and Galaxy, AllUnity delivers fully backed, MiCAR-compliant stablecoins (EURAU, CHFAU and SEKAU) that provide regulatory certainty and robust reserve backing for secure, frictionless capital movement across markets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Risk Manager/in (m/f/d) with experience in structured risk management within a regulated financial services environment and a strong interest or exposure to blockchain-based products. The role focuses on risk framework development, new product and change assessments, and technology-related risk analysis in a digital asset context.

You will act as a key contributor to the Institute’s second-line risk function, supporting the evaluation of new blockchain integrations, product developments and outsourcing arrangements under MiCA and DORA. The role combines traditional operational risk management with digital asset specific risk considerations.

You will manage defined risk workstreams, particularly in the assessment of new blockchain integrations and product developments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core Risk Management & Governance

Conduct inherent and residual risk assessments in line with the Institute’s risk methodology

Maintain and enhance the risk inventory, including control mapping and documentation standards

Assess control design and effectiveness across operational and technology-related processes

Monitor KRIs and risk appetite thresholds, including follow-up and escalation where required

Support tracking and monitoring of recovery indicators and related governance processes

Contribute to material change assessments and structured risk papers for management

2. New Product & Process Risk (NPP)

Perform end-to-end risk assessments for new blockchain integrations (e.g., L1/L2 chains, bridge solutions)

Assess impact on existing operational processes, governance structures and control frameworks

Evaluate smart contract-related risk exposure at a conceptual level (e.g., mint/burn controls, upgradeability, governance mechanisms)

Identify operational, ICT, outsourcing and concentration risks arising from new initiatives

Support the preparation of clear, decision-ready risk assessments for internal approval committees

3. Technology, ICT & Outsourcing Risk (MiCA / DORA)

Support alignment of ICT and outsourcing risk management with MiCA and DORA requirements

Evaluate third-party providers (e.g., custody, bridge, oracle and technology providers) from a risk and criticality perspective

Assess resilience, dependency, concentration and exit strategy considerations

Contribute to operational resilience testing and scenario development

Ensure technology and outsourcing risks are consistently reflected in the overall risk profile

Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data.  We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. jobs.title: [AI Research Div.] Data Project Manager (경력무관 / 인턴)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

지난 2021년부터 크래프톤은 우리가 가진 게임 제작역량을 새롭게 확장할 수 있는 영역이자 새로운 도전을 지속할 분야로 딥러닝을 제시하고 해당 분야 연구에 집중하고 있으며, 본격화를 위하여 핵심 인재 영입 등 적극적인 투자를 진행하고 있습니다.

[AI Research 본부 비전]
크래프톤 AI Research 본부는 게임과 비게임 분야를 위한 자체 AI 핵심 기술을 연구 개발하여, 기존 사업의 경쟁력을 강화하는 동시에 AI 기술의 사업화를 지원하며 새로운 가치와 혁신을 창출합니다:
  • Multimodal Foundation Model, AI Agent 등 차세대 AI 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여 게임과 현실 세계에서 사람과 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 지능형 Agent를 구현합니다.
  • AI 기술을 게임 개발과 서비스는 물론 다양한 산업 분야에 적용하여 제작 혁신, 새로운 사용자 경험, AI 기반 서비스와 사업 기회를 창출합니다.

[AI Research Design Team 비전]

  • AI Research 본부의 전략을 수립하고 실행을 설계하는 조직입니다. 본부의 연구 방향에 맞춰 과제 우선순위와 로드맵을 정의하고, 각 과제가 필요로 하는 데이터와 리소스를 제안 및 확보하며, 프로젝트가 계획대로 진행되도록 운영합니다.
  • World Foundation Model 분야의 최신 연구 동향을 바탕으로 본부의 연구팀과 리더십에 신뢰할 수 있는 로드맵을 제시합니다. 과제 진행에 필요한 데이터와 리소스가 적시에 확보되도록 조달·구축 파이프라인을 설계·운영하며, 계획 대비 진행 상황과 결과를 관계자에게 지속적으로 공유합니다.

[Culture Fit]
AI Research 본부 인원들은 본인 분야에만 묶여있지 않고 서로 다른 프로젝트 팀원들과 교류 및 협업하여 다양한 문제에 창의적인 아이디어를 제시 할 수 있습니다. 다양한 문화적 배경을 가진 인원들이 모여 팀을 이루고 있으며 활발한 소통을 위해 언어적 장벽을 해소해줄 수 있는 방법들을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 연구팀의 다양한 데이터 요구사항을 구체화하고, 명확한 품질 기준과 예상 확보 일정을 포함한 데이터 확보 계획을 수립합니다.
  • 자체 파이프라인 구축, 외주 소싱, 외부 구매 등 프로젝트별 최적의 데이터 확보 방안을 기획하고 추진합니다.
  • 다양한 도메인과 데이터 유형에 걸친 다수의 벤더를 관리하고, 관계를 유지하며, 크래프톤에 유리한 조건을 협상합니다.
  • 데이터 확보 전 연구팀과 성공 판정 지표를 합의하고, 확보한 데이터가 모델 성능에 얼마나 기여했는지 검증하여 기록합니다.
  • 데이터 수집·활용에 대한 컴플라이언스(저작권, 개인정보, 이용약관 등)를 유관부서와 함께 검토합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Who We Are:

Roblox is reimagining the way people come together to connect, create, and express themselves. To support our massive scale, we are powered by thousands of microservices. The Application Networking team connects and secures these services, building ingress gateways, managing the service mesh, and enabling seamless communication across Roblox’s hybrid on-prem and cloud infrastructure.

We are executing on Cloud Bursting, a strategic initiative to enable Roblox’s core services to transparently burst from on-prem data centers to the cloud, allowing us to handle historical peak concurrent players and survive regional failures. You will join our Service Mesh team to build the networking fabric that makes this possible.

You Will:

  • Design and build the service mesh infrastructure that enables communication across Roblox’s hybrid Kubernetes and Nomad environments, supporting billions of daily requests.
  • Drive the integration of service mesh with Kubernetes, ensuring reliable sidecar injection, mTLS, traffic policies, and observability for production workloads.
  • Build the networking foundation for Cloud Bursting, enabling Roblox’s top services to transparently burst from on-prem data centers to the cloud, with service discovery, traffic management, and locality-aware routing across environments.
  • Partner with internal application teams to understand their connectivity pain points, ensuring the service mesh provides a frictionless 'paved road' for thousands of developers
  • Collaborate with the Gateway and CNI teams to deliver a unified, multi-cluster service fabric that abstracts cluster and regional boundaries from application developers.
  • Serve as a primary escalation point for complex service mesh issues, troubleshooting across Envoy sidecars, Istio control plane, and the underlying network stack.
  • Act as a senior voice on the team, mentor

jobs.description:

The Traffic Proxy Services team powers the front line of Roblox — operating the global edge network and high-performance Layer 7 proxies that handle billions of web and API requests daily while defending the platform against large-scale automated attacks. In this role, you'll help pioneer the next generation of our edge infrastructure: replacing legacy proxy configurations with programmable, memory-safe Rust services running on Kubernetes, and building intelligent, automated defense systems. Working alongside principal engineers and key partners across Security, Reliability, and Platform teams, you'll tackle high-stakes systems challenges where efficiency, scale, and uptime are critical.

You Are:

  • An experienced systems engineer with 7+ years building and operating backend or infrastructure software, including time owning a tier-0 service in production.
  • Fluent in a systems language. Rust strongly preferred; strong Go experience with the appetite to work in Rust is welcome.
  • Deeply comfortable with networking fundamentals: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, QUIC and the internals of at least one production L7 proxy (HAProxy, Envoy, NGINX, Pingora or similar). Able to troubleshoot a live network problem.
  • Familiar with how the kernel and userspace interact, and comfortable tuning the kernel to optimize for efficiency and reliability.
  • Experienced with high-performance packet processing in and around the kernel — kernel-bypass and kernel-path techniques such as eBPF/XDP.
  • Able to independently design, build, and operate systems on Kubernetes end to end, and to reason about node-level behavior when latency and resource isolation matter.
  • Able to write a design doc that survives review by senior stakeholders across several teams, and to disagree productively when it doesn't.
  • Motivated by problems where the blast radius is real and the feedback loop is immediate.

jobs.title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Sandbox Platforms
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

You Will:

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.
  • Define and lock down every communication path in and out of the sandbox: syscalls, IPC, shared memory, file descriptors, sockets, brokers, and minimize what each one exposes.
  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

  • Collaborate cross-organizationally with partner teams in InfoSec, Economy, User, and the broader Roblox Safety org.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

  • Real-world scale: Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.
  • Complex markets, rich signals: Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.
  • Strategic ownership: Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace.
  • Impact meets innovation: Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

  • Design Economic Systems

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. jobs.description:
🚲  Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données.

Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition.

Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux !  🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays.  🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !).  Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e :

Stage de fin d’études

· 6 mois · Lannion (22)

Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus.

Le défi :  router les bons bus vers le bon produit selon le test en cours (USB, UART, I2C, JTAG, …), et pouvoir déconnecter physiquement les équipements pour mesurer la consommation sans perturbation.  Tu utiliseras Claude (IA) au quotidien pour t’aider dans la conception, le développement et la documentation.

✏️ Tes rôles :

– Recenser les besoins de test des produits (interfaces, séquences, mesures) et définir l’architecture du banc  – Concevoir la carte de pilotage (schéma, routage, mise au point) : commutation des bus, déconnexion physique des équipements, alimentation et mesure de consommation (précision, calibration, asservissement)  – Développer son firmware et le protocole de communication avec le poste central  – Développer le logiciel de supervision qui pilote chaque carte et déroule les scénarios de test  – Intégrer le banc à notre chaîne CI/CD (Jenkins, Git) pour lancer les tests automatiquement  – Valider le banc sur les produits, documenter et le mettre en service

Le poste est basé à Lannion, Bretagne, au sein d’une technopole à taille humaine d’envergure mondiale (1er centre R&D Orange Labs en France et 2ème site Nokia français). Les loisirs, nautiques notamment, sont particulièrement accessibles par la localisation à 5 km de la Côte de Granit Rose

Des outils performants qui permettront d’exprimer pleinement tes talents

Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Dynamics
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a  Software Engineer  to join the  Dynamics  team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority.

As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise.

If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you.

About this role:

Build and optimize our scheduling capabilities:  model constraints and objectives, design algorithms and solver-based approaches that produce feasible, high-quality schedules across a growing fleet, and replan quickly when things change

Evolve contact allocation  (Contact Allocation Framework) to share ground station capacity across satellites and missions

Improve the performance of our backend services and APIs:  profile, find bottlenecks and cut latency for the timeline and scheduling services that operators and other teams rely on

Design and evolve our data layer  for large, fast-growing time-based datasets: data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query optimization and retention

Shape the architecture of Dynamics services  for low latency and scale, in step with the rest of Ground Platform

Collaborate with flight dynamics engineers, Mission Platform (Execution & Insights) and satellite operators  to turn their needs into reliable, performant software

Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations  through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies

Must Haves:

Solid backend software development experience, in Python

Strong algorithmic foundations for scheduling and optimization problems: modeling constraints and objectives, heuristics, and knowing when to reach for a solver

Proven track record improving the performance of APIs or backend services (profiling, caching, concurrency, load testing)

Strong relational database skills, ideally PostgreSQL: data modeling, indexing, partitioning, reading query plans

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

Nice to Haves:

Experience with constraint programming or operations research (e.g. OR-Tools /  CP-SAT ,  MILP  solvers), or with scheduling and allocation problems

Django and GraphQL (Graphene)

Time-series or geospatial data at scale (e.g. TimescaleDB, PostGIS)

Kubernetes and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

Interest in space (astrodynamics knowledge not required)

jobs.description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate.

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models
  • Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)
  • Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties
  • Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)
  • Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories
  • Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)
  • Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware
  • Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data

Skills you will need to be successful

  • Education: PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Safeguards Analyst focusing on Targeting, Tracking & Surveillance, you will be responsible for building and executing enforcement workflows for our products and services, with a focus on detecting and mitigating attempts to misuse Anthropic's AI systems to track, target, or surveil individuals and groups covertly, without their informed consent, or with malicious intent.

Your work will span an interconnected set of harm areas: the use of AI systems to facilitate stalking, the covert monitoring of people's locations, devices, and online activity, the profiling and identification of individuals or groups, and surveillance at scale.

Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. This role may require responding to escalations during weekends and holidays.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and architect automated enforcement systems and review workflows that scale effectively while maintaining high accuracy

  • Partner with Engineering and Data Science teams to optimize detection models for policy violations and automated enforcement systems

  • Review flagged content to drive enforcement and policy improvements

  • Enforce usage policies with a focus on detecting and mitigating AI-enabled targeting, tracking, and surveillance of individuals and groups, and on distinguishing that activity from legitimate research and journalism

  • Support the Safeguards policy design team by providing detailed feedback on policy gaps based on real enforcement scenarios

  • Collaborate with Policy Managers and Threat Intelligence Investigators to identify emerging trends and flag content for classifier refinement

  • Keep up to date with emerging AI policy enforcement best practices, evolving threat actor tactics, and the regulatory landscape around privacy and surveillance, using these to inform our decision-making and workflows

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience in trust & safety, policy enforcement, threat intelligence, or a closely related field with a focus on privacy and surveillance harms, such as targeting, tracking, stalking, or profiling

  • Experience standing up and scaling policy enforcement or content review workflows

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Discovery & Recommendations
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back.

About the Role

We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office.

jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows.

jobs.title: Software Engineer — Drivers & Virtualization
jobs.description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.  Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.  Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

Do great things:  we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

High velocity:  speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

One unit:  we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

As a Drivers & Virtualization Engineer, you will own the host-facing software boundary of Arago’s accelerator. Your mission is to ensure our hardware is accessible, secure, and performant across diverse environments—ranging from bare-metal deployments to complex virtualized and multi-device cloud infrastructures. You will focus on building robust kernel-level interfaces where correctness, isolation, and long-term operational safety are paramount.

Required Skills and Experience

Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Deep knowledge of OS internals, particularly kernel memory management and I/O paths.

Strong understanding of memory safety requirements in kernel space.

Proven hands-on experience in Linux kernel driver development and kernel modules.

Solid understanding of virtualization fundamentals (KVM, hypervisors).

Practical experience with emulation frameworks, specifically QEMU internals or custom device models.

Familiarity with hardware-level protocols: PCIe, DMA, MMIO, and IOMMU.

Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain high-performance Linux kernel drivers for Arago’s proprietary accelerator.

Implement communication protocols and virtual device interfaces to bridge hardware and software.

Manage low-level hardware interactions including PCIe, DMA, MMIO, and interrupt handling.

Enable seamless virtualized access to accelerators using QEMU and KVM.

Design and implement robust device sharing, passthrough, and isolation mechanisms.

Ensure the security of accelerator operations through strict memory protection and resource isolation.

Debug complex failures that span the entire stack: from hardware and kernel to hypervisor and guest OS.

Support the scaling of our architecture from single-device setups to large-scale multi-device deployments.

jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains

About Flexport

Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.

Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.

Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.

Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com.

Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Whether you’re looking to take the next step in your career or already have experience leading complex technical projects, we’d love to hear from you. Your scope and level will reflect your experience and the impact you can bring.

As a Product Engineer, you’ll help shape what we build and own work from understanding the problem through to release and improvement. You’ll speak directly with customers, collaborate with Product and Design, and work across the parts of the stack needed to deliver a complete solution.

What you will do:

  • Understand and shape the problem: Work with Product, Design and customers to understand user needs, question assumptions and decide what is worth building.

  • Build for trust: Make privacy, security, reliability and maintainability part of your decisions. Verify important failure cases, communicate what remains uncertain and make sound trade-offs about release readiness.

What you will bring:

jobs.description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next  is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.  Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break.  Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our marketplace. You’ll join the  Pricing & Quality  team (a mix of data scientists and backend engineers) focused on curating offers to give customers the best value for money.

Your focus: implement models and algorithms to optimize fees and pricing.

Drive pricing intelligence : design and implement Machine Learning models and optimization algorithms that directly fuel a comprehensive suite of pricing levers

Collaborate  with data scientists and backend engineers to translate models into production-ready features

Design and analyze experiments  to measure the impact of fee strategies or model changes.

Communicate your work  clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

At least 5 years of industry experience as a data scientist and Master’s (or PhD ) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics or Engineering

Comfortable with ambiguity : you are able to make decisions and propose directions even when the problem is not fully defined or the data is imperfect

Practical expertise in  experimentation design and analysis .

Proficient in Python and SQL , and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews, and deployment

Clear communicator : You are comfortable explaining complex ideas and results to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Experience in  pricing, B2C marketplaces or revenue management  is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit,

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Staff Security Engineer focused on Application and Game Platform Security, you will partner with product and engineering teams in China and globally to build secure applications and game experiences. You will own security outcomes across the software development lifecycle (SDLC)—from architecture and design through development, testing, release, and vulnerability remediation. You will combine hands-on application security expertise, including penetration testing and code review, with the ability to influence engineering practices and lead security improvements across complex products and platforms.

You will act as a subject matter expert in application security, help teams make risk-informed decisions, and contribute to the broader InfoSec program in China. You will report to the China Security Head.

  • Set and drive application security direction for assigned products and platforms, translating security risks into practical, prioritized improvements.

  • Assess application and platform architectures, including iOS and Android clients, to identify trust boundaries, attack surfaces, and security risks, and recommend actionable mitigations.

  • Define and execute security testing strategies for complex systems, including hands-on penetration testing and focused security assessments.

  • Own vulnerability management from discovery through remediation verification, including triaging findings, prioritizing risks, agreeing on remediation plans, tracking resolution, and validating fixes.

  • Help engineering teams adopt application security tooling and practices, including static and dynamic analysis, software composition analysis, and security testing automation.

jobs.title: Design Engineer - Canada
jobs.description:
Hi 👋🏾 I’m

Abhik  , Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

You get to shape the UI and UX of a powerful and complex product. Our users need software that helps them move quickly while adapting to their unique workflows and preferences. As a r

jobs.title: AI Safety Residency — Scale Labs Preparedness & Policy (SLPreP)
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with the Preparedness and Policy research team, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

The work includes thinking about various failure modes, evaluating whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Residents take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide AI safety residents on projects in AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AI systems, including monitoring their reasoning to detect harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment red-teaming: Developing science around testing whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: Examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: A benchmark with task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: evaluating whether language models choose harmful actions when given simulated dangerous tools under various operational pressures
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • RSI Control: evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage R&D efforts in the RSI loop.

See more work from the Human Frontier Collective.

What You'll

jobs.title: SWE Fellow - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think. We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who Should Apply

  • Professional and Academic Background: 5+ years of software engineering or related technical experience, or equivalent domain expertise through academic work (e.g. PhD, postdoctoral research, or faculty experience in Computer Science or related field).
  • Skills: Demonstrated coding proficiency and analytical abilities, with deep expertise in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, Java, Rust, Swift, JavaScript, or C++.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion in applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
  • Work authorization

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) focused on Inference & Post-Training, you will be a hands-on technical partner to our most strategic customers — production AI teams looking to leverage high quality models and do inference at scale. For us, FDE is not a replacement for a Solutions Architect; you will partner with our SAs as a deep-domain specialist in inference optimization, fine-tuning pipelines, and production deployment. As key contributors to both the CX, Engineering, and Sales organizations, FDEs add tremendous value by ensuring we can meet the requirements of our most complex POCs, facilitate successful platform adoption, and guide tailored optimization efforts — directly impacting customer success, company growth, and the hardening of our core platform.

Must be a permanent resident or citizen of Singapore.

  • Configuration & Performance Tuning: Develop configuration updates to win critical POCs, benchmarks, and optimize customer deployments; tune KV cache, apply speculative decoding, determine optimal tensor parallelism, and determine quantization strategy to hit throughput and latency targets.
  • Post-Training & Fine-Tuning: Drive hands-on RL training runs and optimize system design; guide customers through LoRA, SFT, DPO, RLHF, and GRPO pipelines from experimentation through production.
  • Strategic Customer Alignment: Act as the primary technical point of contact for aligned strategic accounts — monitoring and optimizing endpoint configurations, helping customers get the most out of the platform, and collaborating to ensure we hit critical milestones.

  • Inference Engine Depth: Expert-level, hands-on experience with inference engines (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang); ability to diagnose and resolve performance issues at the engine level.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Applied AI Inference team, you’ll be the hands-on technical owner for a broad set of fast-growing customers building products on high-quality open models at scale. You’ll work across several customers and get into the details of how each customer selects and applies models in their workload, from evals and prompts to agents and harness integrations.

You’ll go deep technically. You’ll learn each customer’s architecture and use cases well enough to guide their move from closed to open models. That means choosing the right models, benchmarking quality and performance, tuning prompts and pipelines, and integrating models into their systems and workflows. You’ll write code most days, alongside customers and in our own tools.

You’ll own customer outcomes from post-POC to production. Once a Solutions Architect wins the proof of concept, you take the account into production and help it scale. You drive adoption, remove blockers and proactively make sure the customer gets the value they were promised.

You’ll bring a product mindset. You’ll turn what you learn on each deployment into reusable playbooks, tooling, reference architectures and product feedback so each new deployment is faster and needs less manual work than the last.

You’ll work across teams constantly. You’ll work alongside Solutions Architects, Sales, Engineering, Product, and Research.

As one of the early members on this team, you’ll also help define how the function runs, including its playbooks, tooling and hiring. Your work will directly affect customer retention, platform adoption and company growth.

Responsibilities

  • Opinionated Onboarding: Plan the path to production with the SA and customer, and make sure the right deployment strategy, model choice, ramp plan and monitoring are in place before the workload goes live.
  • Model Selection & Migration: Help customers move from closed to open models. Evaluate options on the customer’s own data, pick the right model, and handle upgrades and deprecations without regressions.
  • Agent Design: Build and debug agents and multi-step workflows that hold up in production, including tool calling, planning and retries.
  • Harness & System Integrations: Get Together working inside the tools customers already use, like coding-agent harnesses, agent frameworks, OpenAI-compatible SDKs and data pipelines. Fix what breaks between them: tool-call formats, streaming, context limits and rate limits.
  • Evals & Prompts: Build evals that measure what each customer cares about, and use them to tune prompts and catch regressions.
  • Customer Touchpoints: Proactively monitor your accounts, keep a frequent pulse of how things are going, work closely alongside customers

Together AI is scaling its go-to-market team fast, and we need a Head of Sales Enablement to make every seller, solutions architect, and customer-facing engineer audible-ready, from their first week through every launch.

jobs.title: 3D Character Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Character Artist at Riot, you will bring champions to life by creating and texturing high and low poly models. You will help craft some of the most iconic characters in the world of gaming. Your sculpting skills, artistic eye and keen understanding of anatomy, form, and color will lead the way in character creation. Working within both technical and design constraints, you will use your knowledge of proportions, anatomy and readability to ensure models are optimized in game. Your craft expertise, high-level execution and attention to detail will enrich the player’s immersive experience.

As a 3D Character Artist on the Unpublished R&D Product, you will translate character concepts into game-ready assets that meet technical and design requirements. You will contribute throughout the character production process, from concept to final implementation, and collaborate with multiple disciplines and external partners to deliver consistently high-quality character assets. You will create appealing, distinctive, and readable characters that help deliver a high-quality player experience. You will report into the Art Director of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand the complete asset creation process, from concept design, modeling, baking, and texturing through successful integration into the game.

jobs.title: Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern (Masters/PhD) - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is passionate about protecting the integrity of multiplayer games and creating a fair experience for players. We work across low-level systems, software protection, and security research to help protect the legitimacy of players’ games.

As an Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern, you’ll work with experienced Vanguard engineers on a summer research project exploring how agentic AI is changing the effectiveness of software obfuscation and virtualization. With mentorship from the team, you’ll use and improve research harnesses that iteratively challenge code-protection techniques, measure the boundaries of AI-assisted reverse engineering, and investigate methods for making protected code more resilient to AI analysis. You’ll turn your findings into repeatable experiments, clear technical documentation, and make recommendations that inform the future of Anti-Cheat and client software protection.

Potential Responsibilities:

  • Work with Anti-Cheat engineers to scope and complete a bounded research project focused on AI-assisted analysis of obfuscated and virtualized code.
  • Build and improve AI harnesses that iteratively improve and challenge code-protection techniques to study the boundaries of their design
  • Design and run experiments that measure where AI systems succeed, struggle, or fail when reasoning about protected binaries.
  • Research and evaluate techniques that make software obfuscation and virtualization more resilient to AI-assisted reverse engineering.
  • Reproduce and validate results, documenting experimental methods, evidence, limitations, and potential defensive implications.
  • Contribute improvements to shared research tools and workflows, and present progress and findings to engineers and technical partners.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a Masters or Doctoral program in the following fields: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related graduate degree program.
  • Experience programming in C or C++, demonstrated through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects.
  • Experience with agentic AI tools or harnesses used to automate iterative workflows such as code generation, testing, analysis, or evaluation.
  • Foundational understanding and relevant coursework in operating systems, computer architecture, compilers, and software security.
  • Available to work full-time hours for the 12-week program.
  • Minimum GPA of 2.5.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Graduating in the 2028 calendar year.
  • Exposure to reverse engineering, binary analysis, code obfuscation, software virtualization, or related security techniques through coursework or hands-on projects.
  • Experience with Python, scripting, Git, testing, or building repeatable research and evaluation tools.
  • Familiarity with program-analysis

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Principal Animation Artist at Riot you will define craft standards, coach the animation team and influence other disciplines, including VFX artists, character artists, and rigging technical artists. You will help direct the animation experience and communicate that vision to team members. A great reel will showcase a diverse selection of character-driven and interactive animation, and a strong foundation in the principles of animation, including weight, anticipation, and impact. Your craft expertise will breathe life into iconic and beloved characters for players.

As a Principal Animation Artist on the Unpublished R&D Product, you will be responsible for all aspects of player-facing animation systems and character performance, from early ideation through final shipping-quality release. Your critical eye for quality and appeal will help strengthen our animation style. You will report into the Art Director of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the quality and direction of gameplay animation, ensuring a high bar for responsiveness, clarity, and cohesion.
  • Own and evolve multiple player-facing animation systems, ensuring scalability and consistency across features.
  • Define and establish animation best practices, workflows, and quality standards for the team.
  • Partner with design, engineering, and technical art to shape animation systems and influence gameplay integration.
  • Anticipate systemic challenges and lead solutions that improve long-term reliability and performance.
  • Guide and mentor animators, elevating craft quality across the team.
  • Influence cross-team collaboration and alignment on animation-related systems and pipelines.
  • Identify opportunities to improve tools, pipelines, and production strategies at a broader level.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of professional experience in game or entertainment animation.
  • Experience defining animation pipelines or standards at a team or project level.
  • Expert proficiency in Maya.
  • Extensive experience working with Unreal
