jobs.title: Principal Insights Analyst - League of Legends
jobs.description:
The Insights discipline helps empower Rioters' decision-making to be more data-informed and put player experience at the forefront. We're an interdisciplinary group of scientists, consultants, and strategists from all sorts of backgrounds who join together to represent and advocate for players around the world. We believe that illuminating the globally diverse experiences, behaviors, and needs of players is critical to Riot living up to our player-focused mission. We're a group united by our love of games, science, and helping others succeed.

As a Principal Insights Analyst on League of Legends, you’ll join the League Insights team – a group of researchers, analysts, ML engineers and data engineers, responsible for solving complex problems and enabling Rioters to make difficult decisions with confidence.

You’ll tackle some of the most complex and ambiguous problems facing League and advise senior leaders on key product and business decisions. This role will have a particular focus on game economy and monetization systems, while also helping evolve how our team conducts analytics work in an increasingly AI-enabled environment. You’ll combine strong product judgment, advanced analytics, and technical expertise to solve difficult problems, build scalable analytical workflows, and mentor analysts across the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead some of League’s most complex Insights problem spaces, identifying and prioritizing the right questions, navigating ambiguity, and driving work from problem framing through strategic recommendation.
  • Develop deep analytical perspectives on League’s economy to inform monetization strategy, across questions such as content strategy, spender lifecycle and segmentation, purchasing behavior, product incrementality and cannibalization, and long-term monetization health.
  • Apply advanced analytical methods to uncover the drivers of player behavior and product performance, identify opportunities and risks, and deepen understanding of complex product questions.
  • Develop reusable AI-enabled and agentic analytics workflows, tooling, and reporting approaches that improve the speed, consistency, and reliability of analysis.
  • Help evolve the League Insights analytics ecosystem and standards for an AI-enabled future, including new approaches to interactive reporting, self-service analytics, and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Partner closely with data engineers to align evolving data foundations with downstream analytical workflows, reporting needs, and AI-enabled use cases.
  • Shape product and business decisions through data-driven recommendations and trusted partnership with product teams and League leadership.
  • Serve as a craft leader across Insights, setting quality standards, mentoring senior practitioners, and advancing analytical capabilities across the discipline.

jobs.title: Rendering Technical Artist II - League of Legends (Contract)
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title, League of Legends, to critical and player acclaim. Players form the foundation of our community, and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. That’s where you come in.

League’s visual targets are built on a modern real-time, PBR-based rendering pipeline with stylized, hand-painted treatments, and you’ll author, extend, and maintain the shaders and materials that realize them across champions, skins, and related content.

Working closely with artists, designers, engineers, and external partners, you’ll act as a bridge between art and engineering—translating visual and art-direction goals into robust, performant solutions that behave consistently across around-game and in-game environments. As an experienced technical artist, you’ll also diagnose rendering issues early, reduce rework, and help raise the craft bar for how shaders and materials are authored across internal and external teams.

Reporting to the Technical Art Manager, you will ensure that assets meet technical performance standards and artistic direction requirements. In collaboration with Art, Design, Engineering, and external partners, you will contribute to production support and workflow improvements.

  • Collaborate directly with Art and Design to understand desired visual behaviors and art direction, and translate them into clear, achievable, and performant rendering solutions.
  • Provide hands-on technical support to internal and external vendor artists, helping them author, integrate, and troubleshoot materials and shaders for Epic and Legendary skins.

  • 与 Game Design、Art、Narrative、Animation、Engineering 等团队合作，将抽象体验目标转化为可执行的音频方案。

jobs.description:
Riot’s Enterprise Technology organization ensures Rioters have what they need to unlock their full potential by building secure, reliable, and scalable internal systems that keep the company running smoothly.

As a Staff Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in AI, you will personally design and build the AI agent capabilities and product experiences for an internal enterprise intelligence platform. This includes the retrieval, orchestration, and reasoning layer that sits on top of a semantic data layer built and maintained by a partner data engineering team. You’ll turn these capabilities into search, chat, and workflow experiences that help leaders find information and make decisions faster. This is a hands-on, coding-majority role. You’ll build the agents, prompts, tool integrations, and full-stack product surface yourself.

You’ll work directly with product owners, system leads, and domain experts across HR, Finance, IT, Legal, and Workplace to understand real workflows. You’ll also work closely with a partner data engineering team that owns ingestion, the semantic layer, and the underlying data model. You will consume and help shape requirements for that layer rather than building it yourself. Your work will directly improve how Rioters hire, plan, spend, onboard, and operate at scale.

The ideal candidate is a deeply experienced full-stack software engineer who has personally shipped AI-enabled products at scale, is comfortable building in ambiguous and evolving problem spaces, and takes ownership of systems from the first commit through production operation.

The role will report to the Manager of Enterprise Systems Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain an orchestrator + specialist-agent architecture (retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, multi-step reasoning) on top of a semantic data layer owned by a partner data team.
  • Design and implement retrieval and grounding for RAG/semantic search use cases: embeddings, reranking, citation of evidence, and techniques to reduce hallucination.
  • Integrate agents with internal and external tools/APIs (function/tool calling) to let them take real actions, not just answer questions.
  • Build the full-stack application layer, APIs, and UI that exposes AI-powered search, chat, and workflow experiences to end users.
  • Instrument AI features with observability for quality, latency, token usage, and cost, and use it to drive iteration and tuning.
  • Iterate on prompts and model choices quickly, with sensible fallback behavior when a model, tool, or retrieval step fails or returns low-confidence output.
  • Apply solid engineering fundamentals: source control, code review, automated testing (unit, integration, functional), CI/CD, and on-call for the systems you own.

Required Qualifications:

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

jobs.title: Technical Fashion Designer
jobs.description:
Help Build the Next Chapter of Product Development at  Fresh Prints

Hi, I’m  Andy , the Product Development Manager at Fresh Prints.

Before Fresh Prints, I spent five years with a national fashion retail group in the Philippines, working my way from graphic designer to creative lead. When I joined Fresh Prints as a graphic designer in September 2024, I wanted to focus on designing again. Building a department wasn’t exactly the plan.

I was thrown into it pretty quickly. I’d expected to be designing email newsletters. Within my first month, I was in China meeting manufacturers and sourcing fabrics. Soon after, I became the first dedicated person in Product Development, figuring out how to build the function from the ground up.

Fresh Prints already had successful garments, but there was no established playbook for the department. I worked across Creative and Logistics, built our tech pack template, mapped development timelines, and brought in technical support. Together with the wider team, we expanded beyond a single supplier and launched products like our mock neck, which has sold over 40,000 units in less than two years.

I also had to learn what American college students wanted. Through our Fashion Council conversations, I learned to push past “that’s cute.” Was it the fit, fabric, or color? Would they actually buy it? Those answers shaped our products. Clear specs, careful sample reviews, and consistent follow-through helped bring them to life.

That’s what I value about working here. You can question a process, propose something better, and take responsibility for making it happen. My role grew because there was room to contribute beyond what I was hired to do.

Now, we’re looking for a Technical Fashion Designer who enjoys the technical side of bringing garments to life. Someone who cares about the details, catches inconsistencies, and thinks about how their work affects the next person in the process:

Can a supplier follow these specs without guessing?

Do the sample, tech pack, art proof, and website information agree?

What needs to be resolved before this moves into production?

If you enjoy solving problems, getting the details right, and seeing your work become something people wear, I’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll work closely with our Product Development Team Lead to turn product ideas and revisions into clear, accurate technical information. Your day-to-day work will include:

Create and update tech packs  for assigned new products, existing garment revisions, and Collab or client requests, including measurements, construction details, and fabric specifications.

Review samples and document feedback , including QA findings, technical issues, and required revisions.

Check art proofs and briefs  for garment accuracy, print compatibility, and production limitations.

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As the Engineering Manager for Design Systems, you'll lead the team building the workflows, tools, and quality feedback loops that help customers create design and code that correctly adheres to their design system when working with Figma’s Agents. This work spans context engineering i.e making guidelines, examples, and documentation useful to AI, agent architecture improvements as well as creating datasets, evaluators, and benchmarks that show how well outputs follow a customer's design system. You'll set strategy across these areas, raise the bar on adherence measurement, and turn evaluation results and customer feedback into feedback loops that make design quality better.

This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Figma's Agent and improve overall design quality. An organization’s Design System is one of the key differentiators of design quality as we can use it to make agent output adhere to their specific brand, products and design language. We are also aiming to solve Design <> Code parity and minimize drift away from the defined design system in both code and designs.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the  Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

Master Data Engineer

As our Master Data Engineer, you own the accuracy and integrity of the master data behind every Aletta we build: items, bills of materials (BOMs), revisions and routings in our ERP system. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. You also own the change control process between Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain, from the first change request to the verified change in the build. This is a newly created role in our Operations team.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. You register changes, organize the impact assessment with Operations, Supply Chain and Quality, chair the change review board, and define effectivity and the disposition of existing stock. Second, you build the manufacturing BOMs for our products from the engineering BOMs. You structure sub-assemblies to match the assembly sequence, add consumables, packaging, labels, kitting and the make/buy split, and set up spare-part and service BOMs together with Service. Along the way, you define how system and module upgrades are managed through the BOM.

You become the single point of contact for master data and change implementation. You make sure every build uses the correct released configuration, so that each Device History Record traces back to the Device Master Record.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, engineering changes run through one controlled process, and every change is implemented, verified in the first build and closed in the change record. Product and spare-part BOMs are free of errors, and master data is audit-ready under ISO 13485. Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain know where a change stands and when it reaches the build. Regular comparisons between E-BOM, M-BOM and as-built show no open discrepancies.

jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여, 데이터와 인프라를 기반으로 임직원들의 워크(Work)와 워크플로우(Workflow) 자동화를 가속화하고 그 압도적인 효율화 성과를 전사로 확산하는 핵심 조직입니다.

Data Foundation 팀은 파편화된 전사 데이터를 통합하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent 등)가 즉각적으로 학습하고 활용할 수 있는 최적의 데이터 파이프라인과 아키텍처를 설계하고 구축합니다. 크래프톤의 거대한 데이터를 다루며, AI 기술의 최전선에서 사내 업무 혁신을 직접 구현해 낼 열정적인 데이터 엔지니어를 모십니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • AI 데이터 활용을 위한 데이터 파이프라인 아키텍처 설계·구축: 전사 데이터 소스를 분석하고, Confluence, Workday, Workhour, SAP, Concur, Greenhouse 등 사내 시스템의 데이터를 Databricks로 수집·가공해 LLM·RAG 서비스에서 활용할 수 있는 파이프라인을 설계·구축·운영
  • 비정형 데이터 처리 및 검색 품질 개선: 사내 위키, Slack, 문서 등 대규모 비정형 데이터의 특성에 맞춰 전처리·가공 방법을 설계하고, 이미지·PDF 데이터 추출 모듈과 Vector DB 적재·검색 기능을 직접 개발. 데이터 특성에 따른 청크(chunk) 전략을 적용·조정해 검색 품질과 조회 성능을 개선
  • 데이터 품질 분석 및 거버넌스 기준 수립: 데이터 정합성·완결성을 점검하고 품질 모니터링 지표와 거버넌스 기준을 수립해 파이프라인에 적용
  • Modern Data Stack 기술 분석 및 도입·적용: 데이터 엔지니어링 기술과 도구를 검토하고, 크래프톤 환경에 적합한 기술 스택을 선정해 데이터 플랫폼과 파이프라인에 적용
  • 데이터 플랫폼 및 파이프라인 구축·운영: 담당 기술 영역의 데이터 수집·변환·적재(ETL/ELT) 구조와 워크플로를 독자적으로 설계·개발하고, Data Lake 구축에 반영. 스케줄링, 자동화, 모니터링, 재처리 및 장애 대응 체계를 구축·운영해 파이프라인의 안정성과 성능을 개선

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 데이터 엔지니어링 분야 7년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
  • Python, SQL에 능숙하며, 데이터 파이프라인 아키텍처를 분석·설계하고 운영 환경에서 직접 구축·운영한 경험이 있으신 분
  • Spark 기반 분산 처리와 Airflow, Databricks Workflows 등 오케스트레이션 도구를 활용해 대규모 배치 파이프라인을 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
  • AWS, GCP 등 클라우드 기반 데이터 플랫폼(Lakehouse, DW)을 설계·운영한 경험이 있으신 분

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
jobs.description:
Our Mission  At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.  We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role  You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.  Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For  A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

Your Background

PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.

Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.

Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.

Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale.

Nice to Have

Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting.

BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam.  Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock.  In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.  We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust.

You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back.

You will:

Own the live environment.  Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one.

Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading.  Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on.

Partner with the desk.  Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk.

Debug across the full stack.  Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves.

Own our hybrid infrastructure.  Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments.

Build observability.  Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does.

Change things safely.  Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark.

Raise the bar.  Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start.

5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.  Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.  You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.  At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting.  In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.  And we build at scale. More than  600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries  rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than  $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.  If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters,  this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your care

jobs.title: Product Designer - Visual Craft & AI
jobs.description:
Have you made something beautiful because you wanted it to exist?

Maybe you’ve built a small creative tool. Made an interface behave in a way we haven’t seen before. Used AI to turn an idea into something people can actually play with.

You’ve got a strong eye, ideas of your own and work to show for it. You might not have held a product design job yet.

We’re looking for a designer with exceptional visual craft, ideas of their own and the AI skills to turn them into working experiences. We’d like to see what you’re making.

Make things for people who make things

At Envato, we’re building tools that help creative professionals find, generate and refine assets for their projects. We want those tools to feel as creative and considered as the work people make with them.

We’re looking for someone with fresh ideas who brings excellent visual craft and is already using AI to explore and build. You could be coming from uni, independent projects, freelance work or another creative discipline. We’re not fussed about your current job title or background, but what we do care about is raw design talent who can bring something different to the team.

What you could get your hands on

You might prototype how a filmmaker saves a character reference and uses it across different shots. Explore how arranging and playing video clips could help someone see a story coming together. Or use motion, imagery and interaction to make an AI capability easier to understand and more enjoyable to use.

You’ll bring different approaches, make them interactive and try them with the team and customers. Then you’ll help develop the promising ones into experiences people can use.

This is work on the core product, not a separate collection of experiments that never makes it into customers’ hands. This work matters.

Bring your eye. Build your product experience

We want to see care in the typography, composition, hierarchy, motion and interaction. We’re interested in how you direct and work with AI.

You should be curious about the person using what you’ve made, willing to share unfinished work, test things in the wild and able to change your approach when you learn something.

You’ll work alongside experienced designers and engineers, with support on framing problems, testing ideas and getting work into the product. You won’t be expected to independently lead a whole product area from day one, but you will have real work to own, feedback to help you develop it and the opportunity to contribute things we haven’t yet thought of.

Show us what you’re making

To be considered, send us something you’ve built using AI, a finished product, prototype, website or interactive tool, and something that shows your visual craft. They can be the same project. Uni work, client work and independent experiments are all welcome.

Add a few lines about your contribution, the tools you used and the details you sweated.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:

  • Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.
  • Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.
  • Efficiency</

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's consulting and systems integration partners now sell and deliver Claude work at growing volume, and selling alongside partners is working. What matters next is delivery: whether the partner completes the work, whether the customer's Claude usage grows and holds, and whether the outcome is good enough that the customer asks for that partner again.

The Partner Success Lead owns that outcome. You will hold a book of in-flight customer engagements across a set of managed partners in EMEA. From the day our Partner Delivery program matches a customer engagement to a partner in your book, you own it to a completed outcome: the work finishes on scope, the customer's Claude usage grows, and a stalled engagement gets diagnosed and unblocked before the customer disengages. You wake up every day on one question: what is each partner in my book doing, and is the work getting done.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own every customer engagement in your book from partner match to completed outcome. Know the state of each one every week: scope, timeline, blockers, and the customer's Claude usage trend.
  • Run the weekly delivery review across your book, and bring stalled or at-risk engagements to the weekly at-risk account review with a diagnosis, an owner, and a specific ask rather than a status list.
  • Unblocking. Partner capacity, scope creep, customer readiness, product questions, deal-registration conflicts, and customer dissatisfaction with partner work: get each issue to the right internal team and stay on it through resolution.
  • Own delivery quality and consumption across your book. Track engagements completed on time, time from match to completion, delivered consumption and weekly active use on the customer accounts your partners serve, and the accounts trending toward at-risk.
  • Build senior relationships with each managed partner's practice and delivery leadership. Together with the Partner Account Manager and other Anthropic counterparts, establish the executive-level trust that lets you ask a partner to restaff, escalate, or invest — and be taken seriously — when an engagement needs it.
  • Build each partner's Claude practice as the compounding work: certified bench depth, one repeatable offering in a chosen industry lane, and a published customer story from each completed engagement, so the next engagement needs less from you.
  • Turn what works into methodology. Convert the moves you prove in your book into named, reusable b

Job Title: Senior User Researcher - 2K Sports Business Unit

Location: London (UK),

Hybrid Work Model: 3 days in office, Mon, Wed, Thurs

Who We Are

2K is headquartered in Novato, California, and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K is a global video game publisher powered by some of the most influential game development studios in the world—including Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, CatDaddy Games, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios.

Our portfolio features iconic, critically acclaimed franchises across multiple platforms and genres, including NBA 2K, WWE 2K, PGA TOUR 2K, BioShock, Borderlands, Sid Meier’s Civilization, and XCOM.

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive, highly collaborative environment where world-class talent can Come as You Are and do their best work. We are dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to explore our global opportunities.

What We Need

As part of our Central User Research organization that serves all of 2K, we are seeking a highly experienced, deeply passionate Senior User Researcher to drive end-to-end user research planning, execution, and stakeholder partnerships in service of our industry-leading Sports Business Unit.

In this role, domain user research expertise and a genuine passion for sports are core to success. Our central UR team has an incredible pipeline of high-impact, innovative work on the horizon across our flagship sports titles. We need a Senior Individual Contributor who lives and breathes sports media, interactive entertainment, sports gaming, and sports culture - someone who can translate fandom, gaming enthusiasm, and athletic mechanics into world-class player experiences.

We are looking for a top-tier user research practitioner who brings proactive communication, immaculate organizational discipline, and a consultative mindset. You excel at building trust with game developers, studio heads, and publishing leaders, managing competing studio priorities with calm composure, and leading high-impact qualitative and quantitative studies independently. Because our development studios, research labs, and vendor partners are globally distributed, regular hands-on presence is key - expect domestic and international travel roughly once per month.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Canada to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centres are sited, built, and operated. This role sits where community engagement, government relations and public affairs meet, and you may come from any of them. What matters is that you know how decisions get made in Alberta and can earn trust in a county council chamber, a minister's office or a community hall. Your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbour, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly within Alberta, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data centre markets. We will also consider applicants based in Ottawa who have established professional experience or relationships relevant to Alberta and can spend at least half their time in the province.

jobs.description:
About  BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for a  UI Designer  to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces.

High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing.

Portfolio is required. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Anthropic's Enterprise Account Executive for Public Sector in Paris, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how we win, and what we need to build to get there
  • Be the senior face of Anthropic to the French State, building trusted relationships with ministerial cabinets, senior officials and digital and technology leaders across the largest ministries, including defence, finance and justice
  • Own the full sales cycle on our first strategic public sector opportunities, from first engagement through procurement route, close, deployment and expansion
  • Work with Partnerships, Legal and Finance to put in place the routes to market the State needs, including resale and partner channels, framework agreements and central purchasing bodies such as UGAP

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Graphics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer. This role can be based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Portugal, Spain or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. If you're open to working in any of these locations, there's no need to apply more than once. We'll discuss location preferences during the hiring process. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location.

We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS).

  • Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD.

  • Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR).

  • Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers.

  • Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance.

  • Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers.

  • Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs.

  • Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms.

  • Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms.

  • Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code.

  • Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs.

  • Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs.

  • 우리 모델이 집중해야 할 역량과 타겟을 정의하여 모델 개발 전체의 방향성을 제시합니다.
  • 데이터 contamination에 영향을 받지 않고 모델의 실질 역량을 측정할 수 있는 신규 벤치마크를 설계·구축합니다.
  • 프론티어 모델과 우리 모델을 진단하여, 새로운 모델이 등장할 때 적합성을 빠르게 판단하고 기술 의사결정을 지원합니다.
  • 데이터·모델팀과 긴밀히 협업하여 데이터의 약점과 모델 설계의 개선점을 도출·전달합니다.
  • 대규모 평가를 안정적으로 실행·관리하는 평가 파이프라인·플랫폼을 개발하고, 평가 결과와 인사이트를 중앙화합니다.
  • 연구 성과를 Tech Report 또는 NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등 탑티어 학회에 논문·워크숍 형태로 발표합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 딥러닝 관련 분야 전공 석/박사 졸업 이상 혹은 이에 준하는 연구 경력
  • AI 모델 평가·분석 또는 ML/NLP 토픽으로 AI/ML 탑티어 학회(NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등) 논문 작성을 경험하신 분
  • 데이터를 하나하나 들여다보며 인사이트를 도출하는 집중력을 갖추신 분
  • 복잡한 실험 설정, 결과 분석을 명확하게 문서화하고 공유할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 능력을 갖추신 분
  • 새로운 domain에 빠르게 적응할 수 있는 분
  • 원활하게 업무 커뮤니케이션 하실 수 있는 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • AI/ML 탑티어 학회(NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등) 발표/수상 경험이 있으신 분
  • AI 모델 평가를 위한 데이터 수집

jobs.title: Account Executive, Army
jobs.description:
Scale is building AI for the world's most important decisions. From the front lines of national defense to the core of global enterprise, we provide the data engine and agentic infrastructure that powers the next generation of American and allied interests.

The Role

As an Account Executive (AE) supporting the Army, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and mission-critical production in the Army domain. You will lead the charge in deploying agentic AI, meaning autonomous, reasoning systems, into operational workflows.

We are looking for an executive account leader who understands that winning at the Army is not about a successful six-month prototype. It is about getting into program budgets. Scale already has proven programs across the Department of War (DoW) and in Army-adjacent work. Your mandate is to take what works, bring it to your buying centers, and convert it into funded, multi-year Army business.

This is an individual contributor role with heavy leadership expectations. You are the CEO of your territory: one accountable owner for the customer and the commercial result.

Responsibilities

  • Own the territory and the number. Carry and exceed an annual bookings target tied to your territory. You own the full lifecycle: identifying opportunity, shaping requirements, converting to a funded award, and expanding. You build and maintain a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your target.
  • Replicate what is proven. Bring proven Scale offers to new Army buying centers instead of starting custom pilots. You qualify hard: we pursue work that expands or connects an existing program, or that has a clear funding path.
  • Turn proof into programs. Secure executive sponsorship and programmed funding (POM, program-office, and production vehicles) so prototypes survive the valley of death and become deployed capability.
  • Tactical execution. You don't just delegate. You personally draft white papers and OTA responses, lead complex proposal development, architect deal structures, and navigate the nuances of defense acquisition.
  • Renewal, expansion, and growth. Own the long-term account strategy across the Army. Defend renewals, maintain executive relationships, identify the next use case, and secure follow-on funding that turns a single deployment into an enterprise standard.
  • Partner with delivery. Delivery owns execution; you own the commercial relationship. You stay close to mission outcomes and customer health, and you surface risk early, working with Engagement Managers, Technical PMs, Engineers, Product, and Customer Success.
  • Direct agentic solutioning. Work with your Solutions Engineer and operators to co-design agentic AI workflows. You translate a warfighter's mission problem into a spe

jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
At Scale, we believe that AI will dramatically improve the world, and our mission is to accelerate the development of AI. As Scale continues to grow its Government Relations & Policy Insights function, we are looking for an AI Policy Lead to support policy development and engagements with governments and third parties in the US and globally.

The successful candidate will combine deep AI policy expertise, experience driving regulatory and policy outcomes, and the ability to connect business objectives to policy wins.

You Will:

  • Serve as Scale’s in-house AI policy subject-matter expert
  • Lead the company’s development of external policy positions and product policies

  • Recognized leadership in an AI-related research area
  • Experience working with foreign governments and/or the diplomatic community

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team uses AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build AI that runs inside production systems used by national health and government organisations.

You'll own scoped components of those systems, such as a model integration, agent tool, API, data pipeline, or evaluation, from implementation through to delivery. Senior engineers set the system-level design and client commitments, so you can go deep on making your components work reliably on real data.

What you'll do

  • Own the implementation, testing, and delivery of defined AI components within an established system design
  • Build agent tools, model integrations, and the backend services and APIs they depend on
  • Run and extend evaluations within an established framework, interpret results, investigate common failure modes, and flag regressions
  • Debug production issues in the components you own and resolve them using the team's engineering practices
  • Communicate progress and blockers early, and take responsibility for delivery dates within your scope
  • Work directly with client teams on the requirements and feedback for your components
  • Share what you learn with the team as you build public sector domain expertise

What we look for

  • Experience building and shipping production software, with proficiency in Python and working knowledge of at least one of TypeScript, Java, or C++
  • Hands-on experience integrating models or AI/ML components into a production application, such as calling LLMs, building retrieval or agent tooling, or deploying a trained model
  • A working understanding of ML evaluation: how to read results, spot regressions, and identify common causes of model failure
  • Experience owning a defined piece of work through testing, release, and production debugging
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to iterating on models and datasets
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including raising blockers and trade-offs early

Nice to have

  • A backend or full-stack engineering background, so you can work across the API, service, and data-schema layers of the systems you contribute to
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Exposure to agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, or context engineering
  • Experience handling regulated or sensitive data

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engine

jobs.title: Data Acquisition Lead, Frontier Environments
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join the team shaping the future of AI at Scale.

Scale builds RL environments: sandboxed replicas of the digital spheres where real knowledge work occurs and built from the operating data of the companies that actually hold it. As the Data Acquisition Lead, you will own the commercial motion that gets us that data end to end. You will figure out which companies sit on the data for the next domain worth owning and then go and get it. This is a zero-to-one function with no playbook. You should be prepared to wear many hats, from thesis-driven dealmaker to hands-on operator to technical translator between commercial and Research teams.

You will:

  • Map the supply side. Work backwards from where labs are pushing to the specific organizations holding the underlying data. Build a thesis on which domains are worth owning and in what order.
  • Invent the deal structures. You'll work with Scale’s legal team to define the first version of how these transactions get priced.
  • Close. Own it from cold outreach to signature.
  • Close the loop with the technical side. You need to hold a real conversation about what makes a dataset trainable and become an expert in what makes this underlying data valuable.
  • Build the machine. Do the work by hand first, then turn what you learn into a repeatable pipeline.

Ideally, you’d have:

  • 5+ years across some mix of business development, corp dev, commercial strategy, or early-stage GTM. The label matters less than a track record of building a commercial motion that didn't exist before you got there
  • A strong track record of managing important external relationships
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to evaluate partnership value quickly
  • Clear communication skills and comfort working with senior stakeholders
  • Ability to operate independently while staying closely connected to cross-functional teams
  • A practical, hands-on approach to building new functions from the ground up
  • Comfort working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Experience in AI, data infrastructure, marketplaces, platforms, or high-growth technology companies
  • Familiarity with post-training, RL, evals, or synthetic data
  • Experience with data licensing, IP, or regulated data
  • Experience partnering closely with Legal and Finance on complex agreements

You will play a crucial role in streamlining our Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) through collaborative efforts, moving us from a state of manual, disparate deployments to a more unified and automated system.

jobs.description:
At Scale, we develop reliable AI systems for the world’s most important decisions. Our marketing team builds pipeline and brand across Scale’s enterprise, public sector, and frontier AI businesses, working closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering.

This role owns marketing’s partner-sourced pipeline. You will turn Scale’s relationships with CSPs, hyperscalers, and other strategic partners into qualified opportunities that our sales team accepts and closes. You will work with our Partnerships team, who own the commercial relationships. Your job is to help those relationships produce revenue: mapping accounts with partner field teams, building co-sell plays, and putting Scale in front of the buyers our partners already know.

The partner channel is one of Scale’s biggest growth levers. As it scales, so does this role. The group who builds it shapes Scale goes to market with the world’s largest platforms, and their scope will grow with the channel. This is a new function at Scale, and you will build it from 0 to 1. You will report to the VP of Marketing and carry a pipeline target. We are looking for someone who has done this inside or alongside a hyperscaler or channel partner, knows how partner field organizations work, and can open doors in their first weeks.

You will:

  • Own a partner-sourced leads pipeline targets and report against it weekly.
  • Build and run co-sell motions with AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft field teams. That includes account mapping, target-account plans, and joint pursuits in priority verticals.

jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations. The Forward Deployed PM is the person who makes enterprise deployments succeed from the product side — embedded with customers, shaping real production outcomes, and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

This is not a roadmap PM, a CSM, or a solutions engineer. The FDPM owns product outcomes inside a portfolio of enterprise accounts: earning deep trust with senior customer stakeholders, driving deployments to production, identifying where the product is the bottleneck vs. execution, and feeding durable, specific signal back to the platform team. jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise Core Platform

jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is building the agentic operating system that powers AI deployment across the world's most important organizations. The Platform PM is the person who determines what that foundation needs to be — and holds the bar on how well it gets built.

This is not a roadmap PM, a program manager, or a feature tracker. The Platform PM owns the core infrastructure that every FD team builds on top of: defining the foundation before anything else can be built reliably, sequencing work against real customer commitments and FD team velocity, identifying which FD-built patterns are ready to graduate to core, and ensuring that every capability that ships does so at a bar customers can trust without thinking about it.

The best Platform PMs have defined platform capabilities at production bar in high-stakes environments and understand the difference between what is necessary to build, what is interesting to build, and what should never be built at all.

What You'll Do

  • Define the foundation. Determine what needs to be true at the core platform layer — across each capability pillar — before anything reliable can be built on top of it.
  • Sequence it. Prioritize and order platform work given customer commitments, FD team velocity needs, and what is actually blocking progress today. Getting this wrong means building on an unstable base or building the right things in the wrong order and paying for it in rework and FD team drag.
  • Identify patterns and graduate capabilities. Watch what FD teams are building across the application layer, determine what is genuinely repeating, and make the call on what moves to core — and when. Do not rush graduation or delay it out of caution.
  • Hold the quality bar. Every capability on the platform roadmap earns its place twice: once by being necessary, and again by being done well enough that customers trust it without thinking about it. Keep the platform from becoming a graveyard of half-built capabilities.
  • Unlock delivery team time to value. Forward deployed delivery teams should spend their time solving the hardest customer problems, not rebuilding plumbing on every engagement. That requires a platform that is secure by default, deployable anywhere, observable in production, and equipped with the agentic primitives, eval infrastructure, expert judgment capture, and data reasoning capabilities that every agent workload needs.
  • Partner across the organization. Work closely with platform engineering, forward deployed PMs, and BU leads to surface signal, resolve sequencing tradeoffs, and keep the roadmap grounded in what is actually blocking work.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 6+ years in product management with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products at production bar.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, AI Safety and Alignment
jobs.description:
Scale Labs, Research Scientist — AI Safety and Alignment

As the leading data and evaluation partner for frontier AI companies, Scale plays a central role in understanding and safeguarding AI systems. Building on this expertise, Scale Labs has launched a new team focused on technical AI safety and policy research, to bridge the gap between frontier AI research and policy, helping policymakers make informed, evidence-based decisions about AI capabilities and risks.

Our research tackles some of the hardest open problems in AI safety: assessing the alignment of frontier models, developing control protocols and monitoring methods, preserving the monitorability, understanding failure modes in multi-agent systems and recursive self-improvement. We collaborate closely with partners across industry, the public sector, and academia and regularly publish our findings. We are looking for talented researchers to join us in shaping this vision.

As a Research Scientist on this team, you will conduct research and build evaluations, tools, and datasets that help us understand and reduce risks from frontier AI systems. For example, you might do any or all of the following:

  • Design and stress-test control protocols and monitoring systems that detect and limit unsafe behavior by AI models and agents in deployment;
  • Build alignment evaluations that probe for deception, sabotage, scheming, reward hacking, and other misaligned behaviors;
  • Study monitorability, including whether a model’s reasoning stays faithful and legible enough to supervise, and how training methods and deployment practices can preserve or erode it;
  • Investigate risks that emerge when multiple AI agents interact, such as collusion, coordination failures and steerability;
  • Develop threat models and evaluations for AI systems that automate AI research and development, to track progress toward recursive self-improvement and inform preparedness planning;
  • Work with government agencies and other labs to scope and design evaluations that measure and mitigate risks from advanced AI;
  • Publish research and evaluation methodologies, and write technical reports for policymakers.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Commitment to our mission of promoting safe, secure, and trustworthy AI as capabilities continue to advance.
  • Practical experience conducting technical research collaboratively. You should be comfortable building and instrumenting ML pipelines, building evaluation harnesses, running experiments on frontier models and agents, and quickly turning new ideas from the research literature into working prototypes.
  • Familiarity with current research in at least one of the areas above.
  • A track record of published research in machine learning, particularly in AI safety and alignment.

About the role

As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.

We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.

This is an individual contributor role with a wide mandate and real exposure. You will not manage a team. You will own numbers that go to the VP of Enterprise GTM, the executive staff, and the board.

What you'll do

Own the enterprise reporting layer

  • Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into pipeline health, stage conversion, sales velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment against plan, cut by vertical, segment, and rep.
  • Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.
  • Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.
  • Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.
  • Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.

Turn the data into insight

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.

What you'll do

  • Own the AI layer of production systems for public sector clients, including agents, model integration, and the backend services they run on
  • Build production agents from established architectural patterns, with reliable tool calling, guardrails, and observability
  • Select and adapt established evaluation methods, and design new evaluations for client-specific risks
  • Apply context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model adaptation, or inference optimisation
  • Investigate regressions in the systems you own, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventative changes
  • Lead project planning for your workstream and manage client expectations on scope, risk, and delivery
  • Codify recurring client work into reusable tooling, evaluation components, or guidance that other engineers adopt
  • Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and delegated ownership

What we look for

  • Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
  • Ownership of the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
  • Hands-on evaluation design that ties model behaviour to real-world outcomes, used to catch regressions
  • Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Practical knowledge of handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable
  • Experience leading root-cause analysis on production AI or ML systems

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.

Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

As a Staff Frontier Agent Engineer (Applied AI), you'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production deployment. jobs.title: Staff Frontier Agents Engineer (Forward Deployed Engineering)
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

Every day, we work with organizations across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, media, telecommunications, and government to build production AI agents that automate complex workflows, reason over enterprise knowledge, and operate safely at scale.

The Opportunity

The hardest part of enterprise AI isn't building a great model—it's building AI systems that reliably operate inside complex production environments.

As a Staff Frontier Agent Engineer (Forward Deployed Engineering), you'll work directly with strategic enterprise customers to architect, integrate, deploy, and operate production AI systems. You'll combine modern software engineering, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and frontier AI technologies to transform cutting-edge models into reliable enterprise software.

Unlike traditional infrastructure or platform roles, you'll work at the intersection of AI and enterprise engineering. You'll design production agent architectures, integrate with customer systems, deploy AI into mission-critical workflows, and help shape the engineering best practices for the next generation of enterprise AI.

If you enjoy solving difficult systems problems, rapidly prototyping new AI capabilities, and bringing frontier AI into production, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Build

Enterprise AI Systems

  • Architect and deploy production AI systems that integrate seamlessly into complex enterprise environments, including cloud platforms, data warehouses, internal APIs, business applications, and proprietary software systems.
  • Design scalable agent architectures that combine LLMs, retrieval, memory, tools, structured knowledge, and enterprise data into reliable production workflows.
  • Build robust integrations that allow AI agents to safely interact with customer systems while meeting enterprise requirements for security, governance, and compliance.
  • Rapidly prototype new AI capabilities and evolve successful prototypes into production-ready systems.

AI Platform Engineering

  • Build the production infrastructure that enables frontier AI research to become reliable enterprise software.

Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact.

Scale Frontier Data is the organization behind the training and evaluation data that frontier labs depend on. We build the systems, tooling, and expert workflows that turn hard human expertise into signals that models can learn from, across reasoning, coding, agentic tool use, and domain expertise.

Reinforcement learning environments are now the center of gravity for that work: the difference between a model that demos well and a model that reliably completes long-horizon work is almost always the quality of the environments and reward signals it was trained against.

Responsibilities

As a Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments, you'll own the technical foundation for how Scale builds, runs, verifies, and delivers RL environments at scale.

An RL environment is a real piece of software: a containerized world with real dependencies, real state, real tools, and a grader that has to be correct even when the agent is creative about breaking it. Building one is a full-stack engineering problem. Building thousands of them reproducibly, cheaply, with trustworthy reward signals and throughput measured in millions of rollouts is a systems problem that very few people have solved.

You'll work on both. You'll design the platform: sandboxed execution, environment packaging and versioning, rollout orchestration, trajectory capture, verifier frameworks, and the authoring surfaces that let engineers and domain experts produce environments without reinventing infrastructure each time. And you'll go deep on the environments themselves by instrumenting real applications, designing task suites that expose specific capability gaps, and building graders that hold up under adversarial optimization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams, and you'll still be the person who writes the hard part.

We are building the Finance team to help make data-driven and financially sound decisions for Scale. The Finance team is responsible for improving strategic, financial, and operational decisions by partnering with the leadership team in making critical decisions across Scale.

The Finance team is responsible for owning the company’s budget, helping to drive quarterly and annual planning processes, allocating and deploying the company’s resources efficiently, and performing financial analyses in partnership with all departments. You will have a unique opportunity to work closely with department heads on real-time high-priority business issues and use quantitative insights to drive better decision-making across Scale. The ideal candidate will not only have the technical skills to support their recommendations but also strong interpersonal skills to manage various stakeholders. We hope you'll join us!

You will:

  • Serve as the Finance business partner to support the Applications BU Leadership Team in quarterly and annual strategic and financial planning discussions
  • Engage with the business to manage revenue, delivery, headcount and expense forecasts, own weekly and monthly financial reporting, KPIs, presentations, and other critical analysis requests
  • Partner with Business Unit Owners to own and improve the Delivery and Revenue forecasting processes
  • Evaluate investment strategies, facilitate ad-hoc analyses, and own special projects requiring complex financial models including, but not limited to:
    • Support the launch of new product lines
    • Assess new risks and opportunities for corporate initiatives (e.g. expanding operations into new locations, compensation philosophy, etc.)
    • Drive internal initiatives to improve data infrastructure and reporting
  • Partner closely with the accounting team during the month-end close process to ensure accurate general ledger and company-wide financial statement reporting
  • Develop and maintain KPIs to assist with the decision-making that aligns with the company’s objectives

Ideally, you would have:

  • 4+ years of financial analysis experience working directly in a Corporate Finance or a Strategic Finance role
  • 2 years of investment banking or top-tier consulting experience
  • Management experience
  • Demonstrated excellent project management skills, ability to manage and manipulate large data sets, critically analyze existing processes, and identify opportunities for process improvement
  • Strong knowledge of Google Suite, and MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); expert Excel modeling skills

Nice to haves:

  • A Bachelor’s degree with a major in finance or accounting
  • Experience in SQL and Business Intelligence tools
  • Experience with Anaplan and/or Adaptive Insights
