jobs.title: Strategist
jobs.description:
Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is expanding, and is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:

  1. Building custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens and government employees
  2. Generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs
  3. Upskilling and AI advisory services to spread the impact of AI

As our founding Strategist for Kuwait, you’ll be responsible for growing the Global Public Sector business unit and partnering with technical stakeholders to identify and win major opportunities in the public sector and selected accounts across Kuwait. You will develop and execute on a go to market strategy for customer acquisition, navigating a dynamic and often unstructured environment to make impactful decisions. This role is a blend of sales and technical, and requires the following:

  • A deep interest in AI and data and the ability to articulate technical concepts in simple, precise language
  • Experience successfully navigating and partnering with governments and senior stakeholders across Qatar
  • Working cross-functionally with Scale Leadership, Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Compliance to ensure customer success
  • An ability to earn trust and develop close relationships with key decision-makers and influencers within accounts
  • An ability to uncover business challenges, shape and scope how AI can address these challenges, and build business cases to show the impact and value of Scale’s offerings

At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions—we’re enabling the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and be a founding member of our team, we’d love to hear from you.

You will:

  • Work closely with Scale Leadership, Head of EMEA, Engagement Management, Account Executives and the EMEA Strategy team on overall GTM strategy across Qatar
  • Work with potential clients to identify impactful AI solutions and shape and scope their high level vision for AI
  • Demonstrate the value and impact associated with each AI application
  • Navigate complicated organizations, developing relationships, and answering client questions to qualify an identified opportunity to a signed deal
  • Build trust and credibility with clients, acting as a reliable AI advisor beyond the core operating capacity of projects
  • Specific responsibilities include:
    • Customer Communications
    • Relationship Management
    • AI analysis and thought leadership
    • Financial modeling and commercial literacy
    • Pitch deck and proposal development
    • AI workshop design and execution
    • Creating demos of potential AI solutions using tools like Replit or Lovable

jobs.title: Subcontracts Manager, Public Sector
jobs.description:
Scale AI is at the forefront of the AI revolution, helping the U.S. government unlock the potential of AI across national security missions. We’re building and deploying agentic AI solutions on large, complex government programs that increasingly require Scale technology to integrate with capabilities delivered by traditional defense primes and other subcontractors.

We’re hiring a subcontracts manager to own the day-to-day relationships, execution, and integration of subcontractors supporting our Public Sector programs. You will work alongside Scale’s Delivery team and technical leads to ensure our subcontractors understand where their work fits into the broader technical solution, deliver against committed timelines and requirements, and remain fully integrated into our overall program execution.

This role requires unusual range: you should be equally comfortable reviewing an integrated master schedule and discussing technical dependencies as you are resolving an invoice, onboarding a new subcontractor, or flowing down security requirements. You will need technical fluency to understand what Scale is building and how subcontractor capabilities fit into the solution, while using strong program management and influence to hold external partners accountable for results.

You will:

  • Own day-to-day relationships with subcontractors supporting large Public Sector programs, including major defense primes and specialized technical partners
  • Understand Scale’s overall technical solution and ensure each subcontractor clearly understands how its scope, interfaces, and deliverables fit into that solution
  • Translate prime contract milestones and program requirements into clear subcontractor deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and acceptance criteria
  • Integrate subcontractor activities into the broader Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and proactively identify dependencies, risks, and potential schedule impacts
  • Hold subcontractors accountable for committed scope, timelines, deliverables, status reporting, and corrective actions when execution falls behind
  • Partner closely with Scale technical leads and program managers who will review and approve the technical quality of subcontractor work, while you own execution, coordination, and follow-through
  • Establish clear operating cadences with subcontractors, including status reviews, action tracking, risk management, decision logs, and escalation mechanisms
  • Drive resolution of technical and programmatic blockers across Scale teams, subcontractors, customers, and other external stakeholders
  • Lead onboarding of new subcontractors and ensure they have the program context, systems access, security requirements, documentation, and operating processes necessary to execute
  • Coordinate the flow-down and tracking of applicable security, access, compliance, and program requirements<

jobs.title: Systems Engineering Integration & Test Lead, Public Sector
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Systems Engineering, Integration & Test (SEIT) Lead to own the technical execution of software demonstrations for classified government customers. You will turn customer mission needs into demo-ready capability. That means defining requirements and architecture, running integration and test, and delivering demonstrations on tight timelines in secure environments. You will be the technical bridge between program management, software development, and the customer, and the person who makes sure what we show works and is traceable to what the customer needs.

You will:

  • Lead multiple software demo efforts, from concept through customer demonstration and after-action reporting
  • Turn customer mission needs, CONOPS, and use cases into system requirements, demo objectives, and success criteria
  • Partner with the Chief Engineer and Chief Architect to own the system architecture and interface definitions (ICDs), and coordinate across software, data, and third-party/GFE components
  • Build and run integration and test plans, test procedures, and verification matrices (RVTM)
  • Plan and run demo events: environment setup, dry runs, rehearsals, go/no-go reviews, and on-site support
  • Partner with the infrastructure and engineering teams to maintain integration and test environments on classified networks and in SCIFs, working with security and IT on accreditation needs
  • Lead technical reviews (system requirements reviews, test readiness reviews) and present to customer stakeholders at the right level of technical depth
  • Manage technical risk, configuration baselines, and change control across fast-moving development cycles for critical demonstrations

Must Haves:

  • An active TS/SCI clearance
  • 10+ years of systems engineering experience, with 5+ years in integration and test of software-intensive systems
  • 3+ years in a technical lead role on DoD or IC programs
  • Hands-on experience delivering software demos, prototypes, or rapid capability efforts to government customers
  • Strong command of requirements management, verification and validation, and interface control
  • Experience working in classified environments (SCIFs, air-gapped networks, cross-domain constraints)
  • Comfortable presenting to senior government and military stakeholders
  • Knowledge of risk management framework (RMF) / authority to operate (ATO) processes

jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager- MLRE, ML Systems
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Scale's LLM post-training platform team builds our internal distributed framework for large language model training. The platform powers MLEs, researchers, data scientists, and operators for fast and automatic training and evaluation of LLMs. It also serves as the underlying training framework for the data quality evaluation pipeline.

Scale is uniquely positioned at the heart of the field of AI as an indispensable provider of training and evaluation data and end-to-end solutions for the ML lifecycle. You will work closely with Scale’s ML teams and researchers to build the foundation platform which supports all our ML research and development works. You will be building and optimizing the platform to enable our next generation LLM training, inference and data curation.

If you are excited about shaping the future AI via fundamental innovations, we would love to hear from you!

You will:

  • Build, profile and optimize our training and inference framework.
  • Collaborate with ML and research teams to accelerate their research and development, and enable them to develop the next generation of models and data curation.
  • Research and integrate state-of-the-art technologies to optimize our ML system.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Passionate about system optimization
  • Experience with multi-node LLM training and inference
  • Experience with developing large-scale distributed ML systems
  • Experience with post-training methods like RLHF/RLVR and related algorithms like PPO/GRPO etc.
  • Strong software engineering skills, proficient in frameworks and tools such as CUDA, Pytorch, transformers, flash attention, etc.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to operate in a cross functional team environment.

About The Role

Most of what makes Together AI so valuable for customers is invisible from the outside. Optimizing kernels, scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, and more create an industry-leading platform for inference and post-training at scale. You'll produce social-native posts, technical blogs, performance benchmarks, demo and explainer videos, and thought leadership, all aimed at one outcome: building Together’s credibility with developers. External

  • Replies to social media comments, bringing expert understanding of the technology
  • Own Together's presence in technical communities, primarily X, Discord, LinkedIn, and Youtube. Track engagement metrics, what lands, what doesn't, and adjust.
  • Drive amplification of engineering and research work across social channels.
  • Be the heartbeat of the Together AI technical community - understanding the developers and researchers who follow us and enabling them to be successful
  • Experiment and test new ideas to see what resonates with the community
  • While the role involved mainly online engagement (80%), there is an aspect of translating their deep understanding to deliver highly engaging in-person meet ups and events (20%) in collaboration with Events/ DevRel teams

Internal

  • Be the bridge between research and engineering with the field team
  • Deploy models, benchmark new capabilities (e.g. the compiler, speculative decoding) across models and workloads, and turn results into practical field guidance

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.

When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human. This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.

The work combines research and production engineering:

  • The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers.

  • The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.

Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals

We are building that software, and we are building it Claude-first: Claude should take on as much of the repetitive, multi-step work as it safely can, and people decide what needs a human.

We’re looking for Staff+ full-stack engineers to drive this work. You’ll build across the stack: the products people use and the agents that work alongside them. You’ll work directly with the teams who rely on what you build. Many of these workflows write to business-critical data, so correctness matters as much as speed.

This is a greenfield opportunity: you’ll shape the underlying systems, ship agents that take real work off people’s plates, and design how people and agents get the right context to make good decisions.

  • Design and ship internal products end to end, from the data model to the UI, for workflows that teams across Anthropic depend on.

  • Integrate with the third-party systems teams already rely on, and build the layer on top of them where people and agents get their work done.

  • Set technical direction for a product area over multiple quarters, lead engineers across teams through large, ambiguous projects, and make the engineers around you better through design reviews, code review and mentorship.

jobs.title: Senior Identity Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Identity Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona. This is a hands-on engineer who will build identity controls that reduce excessive privilege and protect critical operations. You will improve access across employee, player, business partner, and non-human identities by building AI-native identity workflows: agentic systems that handle provisioning, access reviews, and remediation within explicit guardrails, with humans approving what matters. Your work will protect the identities and access that support Scopely’s critical business processes, including essential enterprise functions and game operations. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Reduce identity attack surface and privilege

  • Reduce standing and excessive access with least-privilege roles, just-in-time and time-bound elevation, and automated access reviews.
  • Build repeatable identity and access workflows that make onboarding, approvals, role changes, reviews, and offboarding consistent, traceable, and timely.
  • Govern non-human identities, including service accounts, workload identities, CI/CD identities, API credentials, and AI agents and their tool integrations: inventory them, assign owners, replace long-lived secrets with short-lived or federated credentials, and rotate or revoke on a schedule and on signal.

Strengthen identity protection and resilience

  • Protect access to critical business processes and systems with phishing-resistant authentication (passkeys/FIDO2), device trust and posture signals, tightly controlled privileged access, and prompt revocation of suspicious sessions or compromised credentials.
  • Threat-model identity platforms, integrations, and access paths to identify exploitable trust relationships, privilege escalation, and credential misuse.
  • Build identity telemetry and response workflows to detect risky sign-ins, privilege changes, credential misuse, and compromised integrations.
  • Design and test break-glass and recovery procedures for identity services and cloud access so teams can regain secure access during an outage or compromise.
  • Extend the same patterns to player and partner identities where security owns the controls: platform identity federation (Apple, Google, Steam, console), account linking and recovery, external and vendor access, and defenses against account takeover and credential stuffing.

Build A

jobs.title: Lead Systems Designer - Star Trek Fleet Command
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Lead Systems Designer to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team in Dublin on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day – whether in our work environments alongside talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of players around the world daily.

Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market. Our next chapter is bold: we’re evolving the traditional 4X experience in STFC — and we need a bold design leader to shape the content and loops our players engage with on a daily basis.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Designer on STFC, you’ll own the standards, direction, and experiences that define how millions of players experience growth and mastery across our monthly content releases and beyond.

  • Become the design owner and leader behind the feature pipeline, directing designers and UX specialists in crafting compelling experiences for our players
  • Guide teams through the creative process, ensuring they can hit the vision of the game and deliver upon player and product needs with accuracy
  • Get your hands dirty through direct involvement in building and refining novel gameplay experiences focused on resource generation, spending, time gating, and power growth
  • Create systems that foster meaningful player agency and long-term investment
  • Manage and mentor designers in systems and economy design to elevate our standards and craft incredible experiences
  • Shape the design process to ensure the standards of players are met and exceeded
  • Use tools (Excel, Google Sheets) to model economies and progression pacing
  • Collaborate with Experienced, driven and passionate Designers, Product Managers, Analysts, and Engineers to implement features which aim to advance the genre
  • Evaluate performance using data, player feedback, and your own playtest experience
  • Design for scale: plan for long-term content extensibility and system health

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of game design leadership experience
  • Proven experience in F2P systems design and progression modelling
  • 8+ years of experience designing systems or economies for live, F2P games (preferably MMO, 4X, or strategy genres)
  • Confident people manager and mentor, that is able to grow & nurture talent
  • Experience with all aspects of game design discipline: concept, game progression, interface, monetization, and retention
  • A proven track record of delivering features that balance player fun, engage

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

크래프톤 Strategy Div.(전략본부) > Strategy & Partnership Dept.(전략파트너쉽실) 산하 조직으로서, KRAFTON의 중장기적 Sustainable Growth 달성을 위해 전사적으로 고민이 필요한 주제들을 적극 발굴하고 해결하는 조직입니다.

CEO 및 경영진의 전략적 의사결정을 지원하기 위해 전사 전략 방향성에 기반한 핵심 이슈를 분석하고, 신사업·신규 성장동력의 타당성을 검토합니다. 또한 분석 결과를 구체적인 전략 방향과 실행 과제로 전환하며, 유관부서와의 협업을 통해 실행까지 연계합니다.

본 포지션은 전략 및 신사업 분야에서 축적한 전문성을 바탕으로 회사의 중장기 성장과 관련된 핵심 전략 과제를 주도합니다. 복잡하고 정형화되지 않은 문제를 구조화하여 전략적 방향성을 제시하고, 전략 수립에 그치지 않고 신규 사업 검토, 파트너십 구축, 사업 및 조직 셋업 등 실제 실행까지 직접 리드합니다.

팀장으로서 주요 전략 과제의 방향성과 우선순위를 설정하고 구성원의 업무를 리드하는 동시에, 핵심 프로젝트에는 직접 참여하여 결과를 만들어내는 역할을 수행합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • AI 등 신규 성장 영역에 대한 사업 및 전략 과제 발굴·수립·실행
  • 전사 우선순위에 기반한 주요 전략 프로젝트 리드
  • 복잡하고 정의되지 않은 경영 과제에 대한 구조화 및 해결 방향 제시
  • NVIDIA, 삼성 등 국내외 주요 파트너와의 전략적 협업 및 신규 파트너십 발굴·추진
  • 경영진 및 주요 이해관계자와의 논의를 통한 신규 사업 기회 구체화
  • 신규 사업의 타당성 검토부터 법인·조직 셋업 및 초기 사업 추진까지 End-to-End 리드
  • 담당 전략 과제의 우선순위 및 실행 방향 설정, 팀 구성원의 프로젝트 수행 지원

jobs.location: London, UK; Ontario, CAN; Remote-Friendly, United States; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Submit your application to the Economics & Policy workstream at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Weekly stipend of 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Substantial funding for compute and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude Science is an AI workbench that gives researchers a single environment for work that today spans dozens of disconnected tools — literature, specialized databases, scientific computing, analysis, and publication-ready outputs. Claude Science already renders protein structures, genome tracks, and chemical structures natively, and coordinates multi-agent workflows with built-in review for citation and calculation errors — and we're just getting started. Much of this is being built 0→1 right now, in a category no one has defined yet.

We're growing the Claude Science product team. You'll spend real time with researchers in academic labs, biotech and pharma R&D, and research institutes to understand how science actually gets done — from hypothesis to analysis to publication and beyond— and turn what you learn into shipped product. You'll partner directly with our research teams to make the models better at science, help decide which fields and workflows we go after next, and shape what it takes for Claude Science to be trusted in enterprise and regulated research environments.

Our north star is for Claude Science to accelerate scientific progress — across biology, chemistry, physics, and beyond — from early discovery through real-world application, by an order of magnitude.

About the Role

In this role, you will operate, scale, and optimize multi-petabyte storage systems purpose-built for the world’s largest AI training and inference workloads. Storage now sits on the inference critical path as well, so you’ll also build the caching and data-movement layers that deliver KV cache and model weights directly into GPU memory at fabric speed. You’ll manage and scale high-performance parallel filesystems and object stores, evaluate and integrate cutting-edge technologies such as Vast, Weka, Ceph, and Lustre, and solve the complex engineering challenges of operating at extreme throughput, low-latency data paths, and massive cluster-scale storage operations.

You will also build Kubernetes-native storage operators and self-service platforms that provide automated provisioning, strict multi-tenancy, performance isolation, and quota enforcement at cluster scale. Day-to-day, you’ll optimize end-to-end data paths for 10-50 GB/s per node, design multi-tier caching architectures, implement intelligent prefetching and model-weight distribution, build KV-cache offload and reuse tiers for inference, and tune parallel filesystems for AI workloads.

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Part of that footprint is the radio spectrum around and inside each site: what transmits there, what listens there, and what the equipment itself gives off. You'll be the engineer who owns that domain end to end: on-site RF monitoring and detection, technical surveillance countermeasures (TSCM) and emanations security, from the threat basis through the systems that make the spectrum observable, to sign-off before a site opens.

External specialist partners do the hands-on sweep and measurement work; you write the scope, direct them on site and decide whether their report stands. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, sensor health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations, construction and legal teams, and directly with site operators and landlords. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Many of the people who could gain the most from Claude are the least able to buy it the usual way. A teacher often pays for tools out of pocket. A small nonprofit has no procurement team. A university lab that wants to use Claude has to go through funding, an IT office, and a purchasing department at once. Beneficial Deployments works to reach them, through programs like Claude for Teachers and Claude for Nonprofits and through our work with researchers.

What stands between those people and Claude is rarely the model. It's proving they qualify, getting the right price, buying in a way their institution allows, and landing in the right organization with the right permissions. Those steps run through identity, billing, provisioning, and fraud systems that were built for commercial customers. Our Access team makes them work for everyone else.

We're looking for engineers who find it deeply satisfying to remove the one thing stopping thousands of teachers or scientists from getting started. You'll work in other teams' codebases as often as our own, and much of the job is earning the trust of the engineers, accountants, and safety reviewers who own those systems. This role's focus is access. Experience with billing or identity is a big plus. What matters most is that you finish hard things that cross team lines, get the details right when money and trust are involved, and care about who is on the other end.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security and control commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building continuous assurance, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

As Anthropic scales to meet public-company standards, the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control environment over our technology stack is one of the most consequential things this team will drive. Within Security GRC's technical controls assurance function, you will be a hands-on senior contributor on what the IT general controls must achieve to support SOX 404 compliance. You will work as a peer to Internal Audit's IT SOX team: Internal Audit tests independently, and you define the control requirements, monitor that controls operate, and make sure evidence is audit-ready before Internal Audit and our external auditors test it.

You will pair with Engineering, Security, IT, and Finance as they design and implement against those requirements, and validate that what ships actually meets the bar. You will also work with GRC engineering to automate evidence collection and continuous monitoring, starting with ITGCs and extending into other areas of security and compliance. This role reports to the Head of Security Controls Assurance and is well suited to someone who wants to stay close to the work and change how a frontier AI company builds its compliance infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

  • Define control requirements and acceptance criteria across the core ITGC domains of logical access, change management, operations, and program development for SOX in-scope systems, including home-built platforms where the control has to be designed into the system.
  • Set the bar for in-scope systems from day one. As financially significant systems are built, migrated, or replaced, define what the system must provide before go-live, and assess SDLC controls for new system implementations and changes so controls are not retrofitted after the fact.
  • Pressure-test changes for SOX impact during design. Review major infrastructure, system, and agent framework changes for control impact while decisions are still cheap, and keep a clear view of which changes alter the SOX scope, key control population, or evidence r

jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

How do we know whether a model is safe - and how do we know whether the systems we built to catch misuse actually catch it?

Anthropic answers both questions with evaluations. We measure model behavior across misuse, prompt injection, and user well-being to inform training and deployment decisions. We also use AI to investigate potential misuse of Claude, analyzing real-world traffic to surface bad actors and emerging threats that drive enforcement actions. Neither is worth much unless the evaluations behind them are representative, robust, and trustworthy.

This role builds the methods and infrastructure that make them so. Sitting at the intersection of applied ML research and engineering, you'll design experiments to improve how we evaluate both model behavior and the agentic systems that govern it, build datasets that represent real abuse rather than clean approximations of it, and ship those methods into the pipelines that gate model training, agent changes, and launch decisions.

Responsibilities

Evaluation research and methodology. Design and run experiments to improve evaluation quality — developing methods to generate representative test data, simulate realistic user behavior, and validate grading accuracy. Research how different factors (multi-turn conversations, tools, long context, user diversity) impact model safety behavior. Analyze evaluation coverage to identify measurement gaps, and evolve evals so they remain unsaturated and high-signal as model and agent capabilities advance.

Agentic investigation evals. Build and own the evaluation harness for an agentic investigation system — defining metrics, test cases, and grading approaches for a complex, long-horizon agent. Measure agent performance end-to-end (detection precision and recall, investigation quality, robustness) and drive hill-climbing on the hardest harm areas. Construct RL environments to improve Claude's safety investigation capabilities.

Datasets grounded in real harm. Construct high-quality eval datasets representing real-world misuse across harm areas such as cyber attacks, bio weapons, and influence operations, drawing from both real traffic patterns and synthetic generation. Collaborate with Policy and Enforcement to translate observed harm patterns into measurable evaluations.

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • 팀 단위 업무는 크게 세 개의 축으로 나뉩니다. 게임 유통 채널을 다루는 Platform, 게임의 제작 및 구동과 엮이는 Tech, 그리고 게임과 비게임 영역의 이니셔티브를 다루는 Strategy입니다. 하나의 파트너사가 주제에 따라 여러 축에 걸치는 경우도 있습니다.
  • 팀은 회사의 다양한 사업 주제와 파트너사의 방향이 만나는 지점을 찾아 협업 구조로 만들고, 내부 여러 조직이 필요로 하는 자원과 협상 레버리지를 전사 차원에서 확보합니다. 동시에 특정 파트너나 기술에 대한 의존성처럼 회사 전체에 영향을 주는 구조적 리스크를 짚고, 당사가 장기적인 기회와 선택지를 가질 수 있도록 준비합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 타이틀 기술 지원과 파트너 자원 확보
    • 개발 중인 타이틀이 필요로 하는 기술 지원을 정의하고, 파트너사의 기술 로드맵과 만나는 지점을 찾아 협업 구조로 설계
    • 복수 파트너사로부터 최적의 조건을 이끌어내고, 스튜디오 및 퍼블리싱 조직과 의사결정 조율
    • 공동개발 지원, 마케팅 자금, 기술 지원 등 파트너사의 예산과 프로그램을 회사로 인입할 수 있는 기회 발굴
    • 기술 적용에 연계된 공동 마케팅 기회를 확보하고, 관련 조직과 함께 협의
  • 계약 협상과 비용 구조 관리
    • 여러 타이틀과 조직에 걸친 계약들이 서로 어떻게 맞물리는지, 장기 커밋먼트와 비용 구조, 기술 의존성을 회사 관점에서 파악하고 관리
    • 기술 파트너사와의 라이선스 및 기술지원 계약 협상 (법무, 재무, 구매 등 유관 조직과 협업)
    • 계약 갱신 시점을 미리 파악하고 협상 포지션을 준비
  • 파트너 관계 운영과 신규 기회 발굴
    • 기술 파트너사와의 전사 레벨 관계를 운영하며, 파트너사 임원 미팅과 글로벌 컨퍼런스에서 양사의 협업 아젠다를 설계하고 진행
    • 게임 외 영역의 전략 과제에서도 파트너 발굴과 실행을 함께하게 됩니다

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 온오프라인 협상과 실무를 이끌 수 있는 비즈니스 수준 이상의 영어 역량
  • 내외부 조직과의 신뢰 관계를 장기간에 걸쳐 주도적으로 쌓고 관리하는 역량

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Partner with account executives across South Korea to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers across South Korea throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success

  • Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work

  • Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences across South Korea. You will need to be able to run the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives

  • Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers across South Korea integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack

  • Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

  • Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams

  • Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience i

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Cybersecurity RL
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Horizons

The Horizons team leads Anthropic's reinforcement learning (RL) research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to every Claude release, with significant impact on the autonomy, coding, and reasoning capabilities of Anthropic's models.

About the role

We're hiring for the Cybersecurity RL team within Horizons. As a Research Engineer, you'll help to safely advance the capabilities of our models in secure coding, vulnerability remediation, and other areas of defensive cybersecurity.

This role blends research and engineering, requiring you to both develop novel approaches and realize them in code. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers, engineers, and cybersecurity specialists across and outside Anthropic.

The role requires domain expertise in cybersecurity paired with interest or experience in training safe AI models. For example, you might be a white hat hacker who's curious about how LLMs could augment or transform your work, a security engineer interested in how AI could help harden systems at scale, or a detection and response professional wondering how models could enhance defensive workflows.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have experience in cybersecurity research.

  • Have experience with machine learning.

  • Have strong software engineering skills.

  • Can balance research exploration with engineering implementation.

  • Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems.

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Professional experience in security engineering, fuzzing, detection and response, or other applied defensive work.

  • Experience participating in or building CTF competitions and cyber ranges.

  • Academic research experience in cybersecurity.

  • Familiarity with RL techniques and environments.

  • Familiarity with LLM training methodologies.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally and an appreciation for the way business is conducted in different parts of the world

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of Business Development / Partnership experience within the digital entertainment industry
  • Experience creating and executing a global business development strategy
  • Ability to identify and negotiate large scale commercial agreements

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Claude Frontier Academy is where organizations nominate their strongest people to build deep, hands-on skills with Claude. Backed by a $100 million commitment, Anthropic aims to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. The Academy’s first program, the Frontier Deployed Engineer (FDE) Residency, brings engineers from leading customers and partners together in cohorts, and more programs will follow. jobs.description:

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤의 AI 기술을 실제 제품과 서비스로 연결하고, 새로운 사업 기회를 검증하고 확장하는 조직입니다. 여러 Squad가 서로 다른 고객과 시장을 대상으로 사업을 추진하며, 각 Squad는 제품 개발부터 서비스 운영과 사업 성과까지 책임집니다. 고객의 요구와 실제 사용 결과를 바탕으로 제품을 개선하고, 사업성이 확인된 서비스를 확장해 나갑니다.
  • AI Product Dev Chapter는 소속 엔지니어들의 기술 역량과 성장을 책임지는 조직입니다. 각 스쿼드의 PO가 제품과 사업을 이끌고, 챕터는 기술 방향·개발 품질·공통 기반·인재 육성을 맡습니다. 스쿼드가 개발·운영하는 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. 챕터의 목표는 스쿼드의 AI 기술이 고객 가치와 매출로 이어지는 속도를 높이는 것입니다.
  • 스쿼드가 만드는 AI 제품 중 일부는 실제 고객에게 출시해 운영하는 단계에 들어서고 있습니다. 고객 요구에 맞는 기능을 적시에 출시하려면 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 정하고, 제품 품질과 운영 비용을 고려해 기술적 병목을 해결해야 합니다. 챕터는 PO와 함께 이 과정을 이끌고, 여러 스쿼드에서 얻은 경험을 본부 공통의 개발 역량으로 발전시켜 갑니다.
  • 이번에 합류하실 분은 챕터장으로서 제품별 기술 의사결정과 공통 개발·검증 체계를 이끌고, 엔지니어를 채용·육성하며 챕터의 일하는 방식을 만들어 갑니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 제품 기술 의사결정: PO와 함께 고객 요구를 기술 과제로 구체화하고, 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 조율합니다. 스쿼드별 기술 스택이 파편화되지 않도록 각 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. PoC가 프로덕션 전환까지 이어지도록 중요한 기술 병목은 직접 설계 검토와 프로토타이핑에 참여해 해결합니다.
  • AI 기술 PoC와 품질 검증: 새로운 모델·API를 빠르게 비교 평가할 수 있는 PoC 환경을 만들고, AI 기능을 실제 사용 시나리오와 데이터로 평가합니다. 실패 사례와 변경 전후의 품질·응답 속도·비용을 비교해 제품 개선으로 연결합니다. 평가는 고객이 비용을 내고 쓸 품질인지까지 확인하고, 결과는 PO가 사업 판단에 쓸 수 있게 정리합니다.
  • AI 기반 개발 생산성: AI 코딩 도구가 코드베이스와 제품의 맥락, 개발 규칙을 이해하고 테스트 작성·배포 설정 같은 반복 작업을 맡을 수 있도록 개발 환경을 갖춥니다. AI가 만든 코드와 설계를 사람이 판단할 리뷰 기준을 세우고, 테스트 자동화로 빠르게 검증할 수 있게 합니다. 새로운 AI 개발 도구는 생산성·품질·보안 기준으로 평가해 도입하고, 구성원이 찾은 좋은 방법은 가이드와 세미나로 스쿼드 전체에 퍼뜨립니다.
  • 공통 개발·운영 기반: 반복 개발 비용을 줄이고 새 기능을 빠르게 출시할 수 있도록 개발 템플릿, CI/CD, 클라우드, 모니터링 등 공통 기반을 만듭니다. 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 적용 범위와 유지보수 담당을 정하고, 쌓이는 기술 부채를 찾아 해결합니다. 제품 출시와 운영을 위해 인프라·보안 등 다양한 부서와 협업해 안정성과 비용 효율을 높입니다.
  • 엔지니어 채용·성장·평가: 사업 계획에 필요한 엔지니어 역량을 정리하고, 이를 검증할 JD·기술 과제·면접 기준을 만들어 채용과 온보딩을 주도합니다. 정기 1on1·멘토링과 테크 토크·코드 리뷰로 구성원의 성장을 돕고 스쿼드 간 기술을 공유합니다. PO와 협력해 실제 기여에 근거한 성과 평가와 경력 개발을 이끕니다.

  • AI Business Development는 이 과정에서 사업의 동력을 만드는 역할입니다. 제품이 완성되기 전부터 고객과 대화하며 수요를 검증하고, 파트너십과 사업모델을 설계해 실제 계약과 매출로 연결합니다. Product Owner와 함께 사업 전체를 바라보며, 새로운 사업이 실행되고 성장하는 데 필요한 기회를 만들어갈 분을 찾습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 신규 사업 기회 발굴 및 GTM 실행
    • AI 기술·R&D 자산과 고객의 문제를 연결해 사업 가설을 수립하고, 초기 시장 진입부터 사업화까지 추진합니다.
  • 초기 고객 개발 및 수요 검증
    • 제품 기획 단계부터 잠재 고객에게 직접 접근해 실제 과제와 도입 조건을 파악하고, 공동 개발·PoC·구매 등 구체적인 참여를 이끌어냅니다.
  • 전략적 파트너십 및 사업 기반 확보
    • 사업에 필요한 고객 접점, 기술, 데이터, 유통 역량을 가진 파트너를 발굴하고, 상호 이해관계를 반영한 협력 구조를 설계·실행합니다.
  • 사업모델 설계 및 매출 계약 리드
    • 고객 가치와 제공 비용을 바탕으로 사업모델과 가격 정책을 설계하고, 제안·협상·계약부터 후속 사업 확장까지 주도합니다.
  • PO와 함께 사업화 실행
    • 고객 요구와 사업 조건을 제품 범위·우선순위·일정에 연결하고, PO 및 개발·연구 조직과 함께 출시·고객 도입·운영을 추진합니다.
  • 사업 추진의 장애물 해결
    • 기술·데이터·보안·법무 등 주요 제약에 대한 대안을 마련하고, 내외부 이해관계자의 의사결정과 필요한 자원을 확보해 사업을 전진시킵니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 사업 전략 또는 사업개발을 주도해 실질적인 성과를 내고, 조직 성장을 리딩한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 다양한 규모와 성장 단계의 조직을 경험하며, 조직의 구조·역량·의사결정 방식에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 전략을 수립하고 실행할 수 있으신 분
  • 불확실한 환경에서 스스로 사업 기회를 발굴하고, 제품이 완성

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Hardware is becoming critical to how AI gets built, and the legal questions are as new as the technology. We're hiring a Commercial Counsel, Hardware to help Anthropic's product teams move fast, build safely, and get the legal calls right.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Inference is a critical part of Together AI’s vision and growth strategy. Developers and enterprises use Together to run leading open models across coding agents, AI-native applications, enterprise workflows, and large-scale production workloads.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how customers consume and build on Together inference.

As inference becomes a larger part of our business, the product surface is becoming more complex. Workloads span different tenancy, capacity, performance, and modality needs; agentic applications are changing how inference is consumed; and customers increasingly expect deep infrastructure capabilities to translate into predictable, easy-to-use products.

This role owns the product layer between Together’s inference infrastructure and the developers and enterprises consuming it. You’ll help define how our portfolio of inference products fits together, where Together should differentiate, how customers move from experimentation to production, and how the developer experience evolves as workloads become more sophisticated.

This is a hands-on technical product role. You’ll use our APIs and SDKs, study real workloads, test integrations, and work closely with inference platform engineers and researchers to turn infrastructure and model capabilities into clear product decisions and customer experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the inference product strategy. Define how Together’s portfolio should serve different customer needs across tenancy, capacity, performance, workload patterns, and modalities.
  • Own the developer experience around inference. Improve our APIs, SDKs, compatibility, and integrations across applications, coding agents, frameworks, and developer tools.
  • Build for emerging workloads and modalities. Understand how agentic, voice, multimodal, batch, and other workload patterns are changing what customers need from inference infrastructure, and translate those shifts into product direction.
  • Turn infrastructure and model capabilities into customer-facing products. Work closely with inference platform engineers and researchers to understand capabilities and constraints across performance, routing, caching, reliability, capacity, and model behavior, and translate them into the right abstractions, guarantees, and controls for customers.
  • Connect product decisions to business outcomes. Shape pricing and packaging alongside Finance and GTM, and use adoption, inference consumption, utilization, unit economics, and customer expansion to prioritize where we invest.
  • Stay close to customers and the product. Talk with developers and enterprise teams, inspect usage patterns, test workflows yourself, and use that context to form a clear point of view on what we should build and what we should not.
  • Drive products from idea to production. Partner close

There are traditional elements to the role too, like all-hands planning and org change announcements, and you'll run those with operational excellence. But the heart of the job is more creative and will require you to find ways to connect the rest of the company to some of the most consequential and least visible work at Anthropic, and making the line between that work and our mission clear and strong.

Product is the bridge between what our models can do and what our customers’ needs today. Capabilities are improving constantly, and priorities shift as the models improve, and launches can come together very quickly as a result. For much of the company, it can be hard to keep up with what's shipping, what's changing, and why it matters. Your job is to help people make sense of that pace by understanding the work, and the people doing it, well enough to tell its story credibly, and to help its leaders communicate with clarity and candor as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the internal communications strategy for your portfolio, becoming an expert in the team's work and a trusted member of its leadership team
  • Serve as a hands-on advisor to executives - help them think through what to say and when, draft communications in their voice, and give them honest counsel, especially in moments when that’s challenging or uncomfortable.
  • Translate deeply technical work into narratives that land with employees across every function, without losing the substance
  • Get creative about how you connect people to the work - don't default to creating a slide deck when a demo or something no one has tried yet would land better
  • Anticipate communications needs before they arrive (e.g. launches, incidents, organizational change, moments of external attention) and have a plan ready for how we’ll bring employees along
  • Design and implement strategies to boost signal and reduce noise, so employees know what's important and what it means for them

TITRE : Coordonnateur·rice de localisation (chinois traditionnel)

LIEU : Montréal (en présentiel)

SERVICE : Localisation mondiale

ENTREPRISE : 2K (Take-Two Interactive)

TYPE : Temps plein

Nous créons des expériences inoubliables en repoussant les limites de la créativité, de l'authenticité et de l'innovation dans tous les genres.

Notre portefeuille est porté par certains des studios de développement les plus influents au monde. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios et 2K SportsLab créent des expériences de classe mondiale sur toutes les plateformes.

Mais ce qui fait vraiment la force de 2K, ce sont nos équipes.

Nous croyons que les meilleures idées viennent d'équipes qui se sentent autonomes, soutenues et inspirées. En tant qu'employeur garantissant l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi, nous nous engageons à cultiver un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif, où chacun·e est encouragé·e à venir tel·le qu'il·elle est et à se dépasser.

Ce dont nous avons besoin

Dans le cadre de sa stratégie de localisation en pleine évolution, la fonction Coordination de la localisation sert de pont opérationnel entre la production de localisation intégrée, la localisation de contenu (CLOC) et l'assurance qualité linguistique (LQA). Nous recherchons un·e professionnel·le chevronné·e pour se joindre à l'équipe à titre de coordonnateur·rice de localisation. Dans ce rôle, vous animerez le lien entre les développeurs, les équipes d'édition et les parties prenantes de la localisation en prenant en charge la mise en œuvre des solutions de localisation et en représentant l'effort de localisation auprès des équipes de développement nord-américaines pour votre langue maternelle.

Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de porter votre langue maternelle à un carrefour en amont du contenu, des outils, de la culture et de la croissance, en veillant à ce que les expériences localisées soient livrées avec maîtrise et exactitude technique, tout en faisant progresser l'évolution du département de localisation mondiale.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Piloter le soutien logistique et opérationnel offert aux parties prenantes locales et régionales de la localisation, en assurant un alignement de haut niveau entre les partenaires de production, d'assurance qualité et de développe

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Commerce
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Twitch's Commerce organization drives over $1B+ in annual payouts to creators through innovative monetization products. As we continue to evolve how streamers earn and how communities engage, we're looking for a visionary Sr. Product Manager to own the roadmap for supporting streamers through interactive, fun, and mobile-native commerce products.

In this role, you will define and execute the strategy for helping streamers build deeper connections with their communities through interactive features and engaging monetization tools. You'll build solutions for products that help creators monetize (like Bits, Subscriptions, etc) while exploring new ways to help creators earn, engage their audiences, and grow their channels. By focusing on streamer success and community connection, you'll help shape how millions of viewers support their favorite streamers across all devices.

You can work from San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or Seattle, WA.

You Will:

  • Lead the product vision and roadmap for high impact Twitch commerce capabilities, balancing near-term customer and business outcomes with longer-term product investments
  • Own the one-to-two year vision & drive prioritization for features that help streamers connect and monetize with viewers, including future innovations in community engagement and creator monetization
  • Own core streamer success metrics including interaction rates, creator earnings, viewer engagement, mobile conversion, and retention.
  • Continuously run experiment

About the team

The Integrity and Attestation team's remit is to prove what is running at Anthropic: what code it is, where it came from, and whether the machine underneath it is in a known-good state. We build the systems that cryptographically verify build artifacts, model weights, and machines, from hardware roots of trust through firmware and boot to the credentials a workload receives. We also secure the management plane of our servers. These controls protect our model weights and customer data across cloud providers and bare-metal AI data centers, including sites operated by partners.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team. Anthropic is bringing up new compute quickly, across new hardware platforms and new partners, and each one has to meet the same bar. In this role you will set the team's charter, practices, and priorities. You will partner with our infrastructure, data center, and hardware teams, as well as outside vendors, so that integrity is designed in rather than added later. The goal is simple to state: a machine gets secrets and workloads only after it proves it should, and a new site reaches that bar without slowing down compute.

About the role

  • Own the integrity roadmap: threat model from silicon and firmware up through the operating system and workloads, decide what to build, and deliver it
  • Be able to reason about the design and implementation of remote attestation, measured and verified boot, hardware roots of trust (TPM, SPDM), machine identity, and the reference values that define known-good
  • Make attestation the default path, so machines receive credentials and join clusters only after proving their firmware, system software, and security configuration, with no human in the loop
  • Build provenance for what we deploy: signed build artifacts and model weights, independent verification, and tamper-evident transparency logs
  • Lead the protection of sensitive data in use and at rest, including encryption and the chokepoints that control access to it

About the role

Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs.

We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day.

The work sits where research meets product. We work with new models before they are public. When a model gains a new ability, we work out what it should look like as an API, build it, and ship it to developers on our own platform and on cloud platforms. Those decisions shape how developers first use each model. We also own API versioning and the evals that tell us a capability works in production.

What you'll do

You'll lead the design, build, and operation of API capabilities used by developers around the world. You'll work with research to understand what a new model can do and turn that into an interface that is simple, durable, and hard to misuse.

You'll lead the API side of new model launches. You'll plan the work, track readiness across teams, resolve the issues that come up late, and see the launch through on the day. Between launches, you'll make the next one faster and safer.

You'll set technical direction for work that spans several teams, write clear design proposals, review API designs from other teams, and mentor engineers on the team.

  • Lead API readiness for a Claude model launch, so that every feature works on day one across our API, SDKs, docs, and cloud partners

  • Build and operate tools such as web search and code execution under real traffic

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Infra Agent Systems Remote India
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI runs one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. The Infra Agent Systems team builds the software systems that power and automate that infrastructure.

We develop production AI agents that diagnose hardware failures, investigate incidents, correlate signals across the fleet, and automate operational workflows. Alongside these agents, we build the platform they run on, including knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and developer tooling.

You’ll work across two areas:

Infrastructure Agent Systems — Build production AI agents that help operate our GPU fleet by diagnosing failures, investigating incidents, gathering evidence from live systems, and assisting with remediation. These agents are used every day by our infrastructure and datacenter teams through APIs, CLI, dashboards, and Slack.

Core Agent Platform — Build the platform that powers these agents, including knowledge graphs, search and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and the tooling that enables agents to reason, act, and continuously improve.

We’re working on something that hasn’t really been done before: building knowledge graphs and self-improving AI agents that understand, operate, and continuously improve large-scale AI infrastructure.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI agents, distributed systems, infrastructure, and automation, solving challenging engineering problems with real production impact. There’s an enormous amount to build, learn, and shape as we define the future of autonomous infrastructure.

responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Why this Role

You’ll work on two hard problems at the same time: making AI agents trustworthy enough to operate production infrastructure, and building the knowledge, retrieval, and distributed systems that make those agents effective.

You’ll have the opportunity to build foundational systems from the ground up, work on infrastructure at massive scale, and help define how self-improving AI agents operate real-world AI infrastructure.

Remote based in India


Responsibilities

  • Design and build production AI agent systems that diagnose, investigate, and remediate infrastructure issues across one of the world’s largest GPU fleets.
  • Build the distributed services, orchestration framework, knowledge graph, and retrieval systems that power infrastructure agents.
  • Develop fleet intelligence systems that combine telemetry, infrastructure state, operational knowledge, and historical incidents to help agents make better decisions.
  • Integrate with observability, incident management, ticketing, fleet inventory, source control, chat, and internal infrastructure

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Staff Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will set technical direction for and build major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

This is an architect-and-build role. Fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes — you'll set the architecture for these across our global and in-DC services, and be a key owner of the hardest parts, in the code as well as the design. Your designs will span the IaaS layer of a greenfield Vera Rubin data center up to the global management plane that schedules capacity across all of them. At this level the job is as much leverage as code: the standards you set and the engineers you grow decide how fast the rest of Together Cloud ships.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that keeps GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.
  • Own the in-DC IaaS layer: architect and roadmap the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers — VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions; lead its build-out for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs, from hardware bring-up to customer-facing API.
  • Design the GPU scheduling and global management plane: the distributed control plane behind on-demand and reserved clusters across dozens of data centers, including the systems that scale per-cluster limits and automate the onboarding of new capacity.

jobs.title: (Staff / Senior Staff) AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a software engineer, reliability-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero-model and LoRA-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page.

The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands-on production-reliability experience on large-scale distributed or GPU-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered.

A product mindset applies: the on-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on.

Responsibilities

  • Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed.
  • Triage and extend automated self-healing: when the node-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero-model or LoRA-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time.
  • Own end-to-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix.
  • Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Distributed Storage and HPC & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Role

In this role, you will operate, scale, and optimize multi-petabyte storage systems purpose-built for the world’s largest AI training and inference workloads. You’ll manage and scale high-performance parallel filesystems and object stores, evaluate and integrate cutting-edge technologies such as Vast, Weka, Ceph, and Lustre, and solve the complex engineering challenges of operating at extreme throughput, low-latency data paths, and massive cluster-scale storage operations.

You will also build Kubernetes-native storage operators and self-service platforms that provide automated provisioning, strict multi-tenancy, performance isolation, and quota enforcement at cluster scale. Day-to-day, you’ll optimize end-to-end data paths for 10-50 GB/s per node, design multi-tier caching architectures, implement intelligent prefetching and model-weight distribution, and tune parallel filesystems for AI workloads.

2 days a week in our office in Amsterdam

Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement the technical strategy and storage roadmap for Together AI, driving high-performance architectural decisions as we scale our GPU fleet.
  • Engineer and scale multi-petabyte AI/ML storage systems by integrating Vast, Weka, and Ceph while executing deep cost optimization through automated tiering and lifecycle policies.
  • Develop intelligent caching and tiered storage architectures to achieve extreme IOPS and cluster-wide throughput at GPU scale for training and inference workloads.
  • Tune storage isolation at the L2/L3 network layers to ensure secure, production-grade multi-tenancy for storage clients.
  • Code Kubernetes storage operators and controllers to enable automated provisioning, self-service abstractions, and quota enforcement.
  • Engineer end-to-end data paths to achieve 10+ GB/s per GPU node; architect multi-tier caching for model weights and datasets; tune parallel filesystems using advanced profiling; and scale storage infrastructure across thousands of nodes.
  • Optimize end-to-end data paths through advanced benchmarking and profiling, contributing high-impact code to open-source storage projects and internal tooling.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in storage engineering, managing distributed storage at multi-petabyte scale
  • Proven track record deploying and operating high-performance storage for GPU/HPC clusters
  • Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native storage experience in production environments

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Infra Agent Systems
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI runs one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. The Infra Agent Systems team builds the software systems that power and automate that infrastructure.

We develop production AI agents that diagnose hardware failures, investigate incidents, correlate signals across the fleet, and automate operational workflows. Alongside these agents, we build the platform they run on, including knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and developer tooling.

You’ll work across two areas:

Infrastructure Agent Systems — Build production AI agents that help operate our GPU fleet by diagnosing failures, investigating incidents, gathering evidence from live systems, and assisting with remediation. These agents are used every day by our infrastructure and datacenter teams through APIs, CLI, dashboards, and Slack.

Core Agent Platform — Build the platform that powers these agents, including knowledge graphs, search and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and the tooling that enables agents to reason, act, and continuously improve.

We’re working on something that hasn’t really been done before: building knowledge graphs and self-improving AI agents that understand, operate, and continuously improve large-scale AI infrastructure.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI agents, distributed systems, infrastructure, and automation, solving challenging engineering problems with real production impact. There’s an enormous amount to build, learn, and shape as we define the future of autonomous infrastructure.

Why this Role

You’ll work on two hard problems at the same time: making AI agents trustworthy enough to operate production infrastructure, and building the knowledge, retrieval, and distributed systems that make those agents effective.

You’ll have the opportunity to build foundational systems from the ground up, work on infrastructure at massive scale, and help define how self-improving AI agents operate real-world AI infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build production AI agent systems that diagnose, investigate, and remediate infrastructure issues across one of the world’s largest GPU fleets.
  • Build the distributed services, orchestration framework, knowledge graph, and retrieval systems that power infrastructure agents.
  • Develop fleet intelligence systems that combine telemetry, infrastructure state, operational knowledge, and historical incidents to help agents make better decisions.
  • Integrate with observability, incident management, ticketing, fleet inventory, source control, chat, and internal infrastructure systems through well-designed APIs.
  • Own services end to end, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, obs

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Senior Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will build and own major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

The hard problems in rapidly scaling heterogeneous GPU fleets are software problems: fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes. We solve them by building global and in-DC services, Kubernetes operators, and high-performance SDN libraries, forking hypervisors and Linux kernels, and building infra tailored to inference and fine-tuning. You'll own massive greenfield projects across their full lifecycle – scoping the problem and writing PRDs with our PMs, designing the system, and building it through to GA launch.

Responsibilities

  • Build the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that makes GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.
  • Build and maintain our in-DC IaaS layer: the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers, including VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions. Implement and harden the bring-up path for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs.
  • Scale the distributed GPU scheduling and global management plane: the control-plane services behind on-demand and reserved clusters, including the automation that onboards new capacity and raises per-cluster limits.
  • Harden the monitoring and automated remediation layer for fault tolerance: automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference fault-tolerant.
